import { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import api from '../api';
import {
  Lock,
  User,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  ArrowRight,
  ShieldCheck,
  Sparkles,
  Building2,
  Loader2,
  Fingerprint,
  Zap
} from 'lucide-react';

export default function Login() {
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);

  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleLogin = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const res = await api.post('/auth/login', {
        username,
        password
      });

      localStorage.setItem('token', res.data.token);

      localStorage.setItem('user', JSON.stringify({
        name: res.data.name,
        role: res.data.role
      }));

      navigate('/');
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err.response?.data?.error ||
        'Tài khoản hoặc mật khẩu không chính xác!'
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#070D1B] flex items-center justify-center p-4 sm:p-8 relative overflow-hidden font-sans">

      {/* BACKGROUND EFFECTS */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top_left,_rgba(37,99,235,0.18),_transparent_50%)]" />
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_bottom_right,_rgba(14,165,233,0.12),_transparent_50%)]" />
        <div className="absolute -top-40 -left-40 w-[500px] h-[500px] rounded-full bg-blue-600/10 blur-[120px] animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute -bottom-40 -right-40 w-[500px] h-[500px] rounded-full bg-cyan-500/10 blur-[120px] animate-pulse" />

        {/* Grid */}
        <div
          className="absolute inset-0 opacity-[0.04]"
          style={{
            backgroundImage:
              'linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.5) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.5) 1px, transparent 1px)',
            backgroundSize: '45px 45px'
          }}
        />
      </div>

      {/* MAIN CONTAINER - Mobile chỉ cao vừa đủ nội dung, Desktop mới fix 650px */}
      <div className="relative z-10 w-full max-w-[1100px] min-h-fit lg:min-h-[650px] grid lg:grid-cols-2 bg-[#101A2C]/80 border border-white/[0.08] rounded-[32px] overflow-hidden shadow-[0_30px_100px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] backdrop-blur-2xl">

        {/* LEFT PANEL (Chỉ hiện trên Desktop) */}
        <div className="hidden lg:flex flex-col justify-between p-12 xl:p-16 relative overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-950 via-[#102D59] to-[#07172D]">
          <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none">
            <div className="absolute w-96 h-96 rounded-full border border-blue-300/[0.08] -top-32 -right-32" />
            <div className="absolute w-72 h-72 rounded-full border border-blue-300/[0.08] -top-20 -right-20" />
            <div className="absolute w-52 h-52 rounded-full border border-blue-300/[0.08] -top-10 -right-10" />
            <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-full h-1/2 bg-gradient-to-t from-blue-500/[0.08] to-transparent" />
            <div className="absolute bottom-20 -left-20 w-72 h-72 bg-blue-500/10 rounded-full blur-[90px]" />
          </div>

          {/* BRAND */}
          <div className="relative z-10 flex items-center gap-4">
            <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-400 to-cyan-500 flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/30">
              <span className="text-white text-3xl font-black">S</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-white text-2xl font-black tracking-[0.2em]">SUNNY AI</h1>
              <p className="text-blue-300/70 text-[10px] tracking-[0.3em] uppercase mt-1">Enterprise Management</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* HERO CONTENT */}
          <div className="relative z-10 mt-12">
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-full border border-cyan-400/20 bg-cyan-400/[0.08] mb-8">
              <Sparkles size={14} className="text-cyan-300" />
              <span className="text-cyan-200 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wider">SMART BUSINESS ECOSYSTEM</span>
            </div>

            <h2 className="text-4xl xl:text-[52px] leading-[1.2] font-bold text-white tracking-tight">
              Quản trị doanh nghiệp
              <span className="block mt-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-300 via-blue-300 to-indigo-300 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                thông minh hơn.
              </span>
            </h2>

            <p className="text-blue-100/60 text-base leading-8 mt-7 max-w-md">
              Một nền tảng quản trị toàn diện, kết hợp sức mạnh AI
              giúp tối ưu vận hành, quản lý dữ liệu và phát triển
              doanh nghiệp trong kỷ nguyên số.
            </p>

            {/* FEATURES */}
            <div className="mt-12 space-y-5">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.07] border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <Zap size={20} className="text-cyan-300" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-white text-sm font-semibold">Quản trị thông minh</p>
                  <p className="text-blue-200/50 text-xs mt-1">Tối ưu quy trình vận hành doanh nghiệp</p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.07] border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <ShieldCheck size={20} className="text-cyan-300" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-white text-sm font-semibold">Bảo mật hệ thống</p>
                  <p className="text-blue-200/50 text-xs mt-1">Kiểm soát truy cập và dữ liệu an toàn</p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.07] border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <Building2 size={20} className="text-cyan-300" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-white text-sm font-semibold">Hệ sinh thái doanh nghiệp</p>
                  <p className="text-blue-200/50 text-xs mt-1">Quản lý tập trung trên một nền tảng</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* FOOTER */}
          <div className="relative z-10 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-white/10 pt-6">
            <p className="text-blue-200/40 text-xs">© 2026 SUNNY AI</p>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-blue-200/50 text-xs">
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 shadow-[0_0_10px_#34d399]" />
              System Operational
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* RIGHT PANEL - LOGIN FORM */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center p-6 sm:p-12 lg:p-14 relative">
          
          {/* Mobile background decoration */}
          <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-64 h-64 bg-blue-500/10 blur-[100px] pointer-events-none" />

          <div className="w-full max-w-[390px] relative z-10">
            
            {/* MOBILE LOGO */}
            <div className="lg:hidden flex justify-center mb-8 sm:mb-10">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-400 to-cyan-500 flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/30">
                  <span className="text-white text-2xl font-black">S</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h1 className="text-white text-xl font-black tracking-[0.15em]">SUNNY AI</h1>
                  <p className="text-blue-300/60 text-[9px] tracking-[0.2em]">ENTERPRISE SYSTEM</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* TITLE */}
            <div className="mb-8 sm:mb-10">
              <div className="w-12 h-1 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 to-blue-500 mb-6 sm:mb-7" />
              <h2 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Chào mừng trở lại</h2>
              <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-2 sm:mt-3 leading-6">
                Đăng nhập để tiếp tục quản lý hệ thống doanh nghiệp của bạn.
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* SECURITY LABEL */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-6 sm:mb-8 text-xs text-blue-300/70">
              <Fingerprint size={16} />
              <span>SECURE AUTHENTICATION</span>
              <span className="flex-1 h-px bg-white/10 ml-2" />
            </div>

            {/* ERROR */}
            {error && (
              <div className="mb-6 flex items-center gap-3 p-4 rounded-xl bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/30 text-red-300 text-sm">
                <ShieldCheck size={18} className="shrink-0" />
                <span>{error}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* FORM */}
            <form onSubmit={handleLogin} className="space-y-5 sm:space-y-6">
              {/* USERNAME */}
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-300 text-sm font-semibold mb-2 sm:mb-3">
                  Tên đăng nhập
                </label>
                <div className="relative group">
                  <User size={19} className="absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500 group-focus-within:text-cyan-400 transition-colors" />
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="Nhập tên đăng nhập"
                    value={username}
                    onChange={e => setUsername(e.target.value)}
                    autoComplete="username"
                    required
                    className="w-full h-12 sm:h-14 bg-[#0B1425] border border-white/[0.09] rounded-xl pl-12 pr-4 text-white text-sm placeholder:text-slate-600 outline-none transition-all duration-300 focus:border-blue-400/70 focus:bg-[#101F36] focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* PASSWORD */}
              <div>
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-2 sm:mb-3">
                  <label className="text-slate-300 text-sm font-semibold">Mật khẩu</label>
                </div>
                <div className="relative group">
                  <Lock size={19} className="absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500 group-focus-within:text-cyan-400 transition-colors" />
                  <input
                    type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                    placeholder="Nhập mật khẩu"
                    value={password}
                    onChange={e => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                    autoComplete="current-password"
                    required
                    className="w-full h-12 sm:h-14 bg-[#0B1425] border border-white/[0.09] rounded-xl pl-12 pr-12 text-white text-sm placeholder:text-slate-600 outline-none transition-all duration-300 focus:border-blue-400/70 focus:bg-[#101F36] focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10"
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                    className="absolute right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500 hover:text-cyan-400 transition-colors"
                    aria-label={showPassword ? 'Ẩn mật khẩu' : 'Hiện mật khẩu'}
                  >
                    {showPassword ? <EyeOff size={19} /> : <Eye size={19} />}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* SUBMIT */}
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={loading}
                className="w-full h-12 sm:h-14 mt-2 sm:mt-4 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 via-blue-500 to-cyan-500 hover:from-blue-500 hover:via-blue-400 hover:to-cyan-400 text-white font-bold text-sm tracking-wide shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/20 hover:shadow-blue-500/40 transition-all duration-300 active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-60 disabled:cursor-not-allowed flex items-center justify-center gap-3 group"
              >
                {loading ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 size={20} className="animate-spin" />
                    ĐANG XÁC THỰC...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    ĐĂNG NHẬP HỆ THỐNG
                    <ArrowRight size={19} className="group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform" />
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </form>

            {/* SECURITY FOOTER */}
            <div className="mt-8 sm:mt-10 pt-6 sm:pt-7 border-t border-white/[0.08]">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-slate-500 text-xs">
                <Lock size={13} />
                <span>Kết nối bảo mật và được mã hóa</span>
              </div>

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../api';
import { Plus, X, Megaphone, Target, TrendingUp } from 'lucide-react';
import DataTable from '../components/DataTable';

export default function Marketing() {
  const [campaigns, setCampaigns] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  
  // State Modal Thêm chiến dịch
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    title: '', channel: 'Facebook', budget: 0, kpi_target: 0
  });

  const fetchCampaigns = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    api.get('/marketing')
      .then(res => setCampaigns(res.data.data))
      .catch(err => console.error(err))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    // Bọc setTimeout để tránh cảnh báo setState đồng bộ trong React 18
    const timer = setTimeout(() => { fetchCampaigns(); }, 0);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);

  const handleSave = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      const payload = {
        ...formData,
        budget: Number(formData.budget),
        kpi_target: Number(formData.kpi_target)
      };
      await api.post('/marketing', payload);
      setIsModalOpen(false);
      fetchCampaigns();
    } catch (err) {
      alert('Lỗi: ' + (err.response?.data?.error || err.message));
    }
  };

  const columns = [
    { header: 'Tên chiến dịch', accessor: 'title', render: (r) => (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-[200px]">
        <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
          <Megaphone size={20} />
        </div>
        <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 line-clamp-2">{r.title}</span>
      </div>
    )},
    { header: 'Kênh', accessor: 'channel', render: (r) => (
      <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap">{r.channel}</span>
    )},
    { header: 'Ngân sách', accessor: 'budget', render: (r) => (
      <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap">{Number(r.budget).toLocaleString('vi-VN')} đ</span>
    )},
    { header: 'Mục tiêu (Khách)', accessor: 'kpi_target', render: (r) => (
      <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-slate-600 whitespace-nowrap"><Target size={14}/> {r.kpi_target}</span>
    )},
    { header: 'Kết quả đạt', accessor: 'result', render: (r) => {
      const percent = r.kpi_target > 0 ? Math.round((r.result / r.kpi_target) * 100) : 0;
      return (
        // Thêm min-w để thanh tiến trình không bị bóp méo trên mobile
        <div className="min-w-[120px]">
          <div className="flex justify-between text-xs mb-1">
            <span className="font-semibold text-emerald-600">{r.result} khách</span>
            <span className="text-slate-500">{percent}%</span>
          </div>
          <div className="w-full bg-slate-200 rounded-full h-1.5">
            <div className={`h-1.5 rounded-full ${percent >= 100 ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-blue-500'}`} style={{ width: `${Math.min(percent, 100)}%` }}></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }}
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* HEADER: Mobile xếp dọc */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
            <TrendingUp className="text-blue-600 shrink-0" /> Quản lý Tiếp thị
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mt-1">Theo dõi hiệu quả các chiến dịch quảng cáo.</p>
        </div>
        
        <button 
          onClick={() => { setFormData({ title: '', channel: 'Facebook', budget: 0, kpi_target: 0 }); setIsModalOpen(true); }} 
          className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-blue-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 transition shadow-sm w-full sm:w-auto shrink-0"
        >
          <Plus size={18} /> Tạo chiến dịch
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Bảng Dữ liệu */}
      <DataTable columns={columns} data={campaigns} loading={loading} />

      {/* Modal Thêm Chiến dịch */}
      {isModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4">
          {/* Modal tự động co giãn, có thanh cuộn dọc */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-[500px] max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto flex flex-col">
            
            <div className="bg-slate-50 px-4 sm:px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex justify-between items-center sticky top-0 z-10 shrink-0">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-lg text-slate-800">Tạo Chiến dịch mới</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-red-500 p-1"><X size={20} /></button>
            </div>
            
            <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="p-4 sm:p-6 space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">Tên chiến dịch *</label>
                <input required type="text" value={formData.title} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, title: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" placeholder="VD: Khuyến mãi Thảm 3D mùa đông" />
              </div>

              {/* Grid: 1 cột trên mobile, 2 cột trên desktop */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">Kênh chạy *</label>
                  <select required value={formData.channel} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, channel: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500">
                    <option value="Facebook">Facebook</option>
                    <option value="Google">Google Ads</option>
                    <option value="TikTok">TikTok</option>
                    <option value="Zalo">Zalo</option>
                    <option value="Khác">Khác</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">Ngân sách dự kiến (đ) *</label>
                  <input required type="number" min="0" step="100000" value={formData.budget} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, budget: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">Mục tiêu (Số lượng khách hàng) *</label>
                <input required type="number" min="0" value={formData.kpi_target} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, kpi_target: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" />
              </div>

              {/* Nút bấm: Mobile xếp dọc */}
              <div className="pt-4 flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row justify-end gap-3 border-t">

                <button type="submit" className="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 shadow-md w-full sm:w-auto">Lưu chiến dịch</button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../api';
import { Plus, X, CheckCircle, DollarSign, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import DataTable from '../components/DataTable';

export default function Orders() {
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState([]);
  const [partners, setPartners] = useState([]);
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({ type: 'sale', partner_id: '', items: [] });

  const fetchData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [resOrders, resPartners, resItems] = await Promise.all([
        api.get('/orders'),
        api.get('/partners'),
        api.get('/items')
      ]);
      setOrders(resOrders.data.data);
      setPartners(resPartners.data.data);
      setItems(resItems.data.data);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    // Giữ nguyên setTimeout để tránh lỗi cảnh báo setState trong React 18
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      fetchData();
    }, 0);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);

  const handleAddItemRow = () => {
    setFormData({ ...formData, items: [...formData.items, { item_id: '', qty: 1, unit_price: 0 }] });
  };

  const handleRemoveItemRow = (index) => {
    const newItems = [...formData.items];
    newItems.splice(index, 1);
    setFormData({ ...formData, items: newItems });
  };

  const handleItemChange = (index, field, value) => {
    const newItems = [...formData.items];
    newItems[index][field] = value;
    if (field === 'item_id') {
      const selectedItem = items.find(i => i.id === Number(value));
      if (selectedItem) newItems[index].unit_price = formData.type === 'sale' ? selectedItem.price_out : selectedItem.price_in;
    }
    setFormData({ ...formData, items: newItems });
  };

  const calculateTotal = () => formData.items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.qty * item.unit_price), 0);

  const handleSaveOrder = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      const payload = {
        ...formData,
        partner_id: Number(formData.partner_id),
        items: formData.items.map(i => ({ item_id: Number(i.item_id), qty: Number(i.qty), unit_price: Number(i.unit_price) }))
      };
      await api.post('/orders', payload);
      setIsModalOpen(false);
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) { alert('Lỗi: ' + (err.response?.data?.error || err.message)); }
  };

  const handleApprove = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Duyệt đơn hàng này? Hệ thống sẽ tự động trừ kho.')) return;
    try {
      await api.post(`/orders/${id}/approve`);
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) { alert('Không thể duyệt: ' + (err.response?.data?.error || err.message)); }
  };

  const handlePayment = async (id, remaining) => {
    const amount = window.prompt(`Nhập số tiền thu (Còn nợ: ${remaining.toLocaleString()} đ):`, remaining);
    if (!amount || isNaN(amount)) return;
    try {
      await api.post(`/orders/${id}/payments`, { amount: Number(amount), method: 'transfer' });
      alert('Đã thu tiền thành công!');
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) { alert('Lỗi thu tiền: ' + (err.response?.data?.error || err.message)); }
  };

  const columns = [
    { header: 'Mã Đơn', accessor: 'code', render: (r) => <span className="font-bold text-blue-600 whitespace-nowrap">{r.code}</span> },
    { header: 'Loại', accessor: 'type', render: (r) => <span className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap ${r.type === 'sale' ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700' : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700'}`}>{r.type === 'sale' ? 'Bán hàng' : 'Nhập hàng'}</span> },
    { header: 'Khách/NCC', accessor: 'partner_id', render: (r) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{r.partner_id}</span> },
    { header: 'Tổng tiền', accessor: 'total', render: (r) => <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 whitespace-nowrap">{r.total.toLocaleString()} đ</span> },
    { header: 'Thanh toán', accessor: 'payment_status', render: (r) => <span className={`font-semibold whitespace-nowrap ${r.payment_status === 'paid' ? 'text-emerald-600' : 'text-red-500'}`}>{r.payment_status === 'paid' ? 'Đã trả đủ' : r.payment_status === 'partial' ? 'Cọc 1 phần' : 'Chưa trả'}</span> },
    { header: 'Trạng thái', accessor: 'status', render: (r) => <span className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-bold uppercase whitespace-nowrap">{r.status}</span> },
    { header: 'Thao tác', accessor: 'id', render: (r) => (
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        {r.status === 'draft' && <button onClick={() => handleApprove(r.id)} className="text-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-50 p-2 rounded" title="Duyệt đơn"><CheckCircle size={18} /></button>}
        {r.payment_status !== 'paid' && r.type === 'sale' && <button onClick={() => handlePayment(r.id, r.total - r.paid_amount)} className="text-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-50 p-2 rounded" title="Thu tiền"><DollarSign size={18} /></button>}
      </div>
    )}
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* HEADER: Mobile xếp dọc */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800">Quản lý Đơn hàng</h1>
        <button 
          onClick={() => { setFormData({ type: 'sale', partner_id: '', items: [] }); setIsModalOpen(true); }} 
          className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-blue-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 transition shadow-sm w-full sm:w-auto shrink-0"
        >
          <Plus size={18} /> Tạo đơn hàng
        </button>
      </div>

      <DataTable columns={columns} data={orders} loading={loading} />

      {isModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4">
          {/* Modal: Mobile full width, Desktop 700px. Dùng flex-col để ghim header */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-[700px] max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
            
            <div className="bg-slate-50 px-4 sm:px-6 py-4 border-b flex justify-between items-center shrink-0 sticky top-0 z-10">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-lg text-slate-800">Tạo Đơn Hàng Mới</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-red-500 p-1"><X size={20} /></button>
            </div>
            
            {/* Thanh cuộn áp dụng cho phần thân form */}
            <form onSubmit={handleSaveOrder} className="p-4 sm:p-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1 space-y-4">
              
              {/* Grid: Mobile 1 cột, Desktop 2 cột */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-1">Loại đơn</label>
                  <select value={formData.type} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, type: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500">
                    <option value="sale">Đơn Bán Hàng</option>
                    <option value="purchase">Đơn Nhập Hàng</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-1">Chọn Khách / NCC *</label>
                  <select required value={formData.partner_id} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, partner_id: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500">
                    <option value="">-- Chọn --</option>
                    {partners.filter(p => p.type === (formData.type === 'sale' ? 'customer' : 'supplier')).map(p => <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.name}</option>)}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* KHỐI SẢN PHẨM */}
              <div className="border rounded-lg p-3 sm:p-4 mt-4 bg-slate-50">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
                  <h4 className="font-semibold text-slate-700">Sản phẩm</h4>
                  <button type="button" onClick={handleAddItemRow} className="text-sm text-blue-600 font-medium flex items-center gap-1 hover:bg-blue-50 px-2 py-1 rounded transition">
                    <Plus size={14}/> Thêm dòng
                  </button>
                </div>
                
                {formData.items.length === 0 && (
                  <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 italic text-center py-2">Chưa có sản phẩm nào. Bấm "Thêm dòng" để chọn.</p>
                )}

                {formData.items.map((row, idx) => (
                  // Mỗi dòng sản phẩm: Mobile xếp dọc, Desktop xếp ngang
                  <div key={idx} className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2 sm:items-end mb-4 sm:mb-2 p-3 sm:p-0 bg-white sm:bg-transparent rounded-lg border sm:border-0 shadow-sm sm:shadow-none">
                    
                    {/* Chọn sản phẩm (Full width) */}
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <label className="text-xs mb-1 block font-medium text-slate-600">Sản phẩm</label>
                      <select required value={row.item_id} onChange={e => handleItemChange(idx, 'item_id', e.target.value)} className="w-full px-2 py-2 sm:py-1.5 border rounded-lg text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500">
                        <option value="">-- Chọn --</option>
                        {items.filter(i => i.type === (formData.type === 'sale' ? 'product' : 'material')).map(i => <option key={i.id} value={i.id}>{i.name}</option>)}
                      </select>
                    </div>

                      <div className="flex-1 sm:w-20 shrink-0">
                        <label className="text-xs mb-1 block font-medium text-slate-600">SL</label>

                      </div>
                      <div className="flex-1 sm:w-28 shrink-0">
                        <label className="text-xs mb-1 block font-medium text-slate-600">Đơn giá</label>
                        <input type="number" required value={row.unit_price} onChange={e => handleItemChange(idx, 'unit_price', e.target.value)} className="w-full px-2 py-2 sm:py-1.5 border rounded-lg text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" />
                      </div>
                      
                      {/* Nút xóa (Nằm bên phải SL + Giá) */}
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => handleRemoveItemRow(idx)} className="text-red-500 hover:bg-red-100 bg-red-50 p-2 rounded mb-0.5 sm:mb-0 transition shrink-0">
                        <Trash2 size={16}/>
                      </button>
                    </div>

                  </div>
                ))}

              {/* TỔNG TIỀN & NÚT LƯU */}
              <div className="flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row justify-between items-center pt-4 border-t gap-4">

                  Lưu Đơn

        </div>

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../api';
import { Search, Plus, Edit2, X, Trash2, Users, Truck } from 'lucide-react';
import DataTable from '../components/DataTable';

export default function Partners() {
  const [partners, setPartners] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState('all');
  
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [currentPartner, setCurrentPartner] = useState(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    type: 'customer', code: '', name: '', company_name: '', contact_person: '', 
    phone: '', email: '', tax_code: '', address: '', category: 'Khách lẻ', 
    bank_account: '', bank_name: '', credit_limit: 0, payment_term: 0
  });

  const fetchPartners = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    api.get('/partners')
      .then(res => setPartners(res.data.data))
      .catch(err => console.error(err))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => { fetchPartners(); }, 0);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);

  const filteredPartners = partners.filter(p => {
    const matchSearch = p.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) || p.code.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase());
    const matchType = filterType === 'all' || p.type === filterType;
    return matchSearch && matchType;
  });

  const handleAddNew = () => {
    setCurrentPartner(null);
    setFormData({
      type: 'customer', code: '', name: '', company_name: '', contact_person: '', 
      phone: '', email: '', tax_code: '', address: '', category: 'Khách lẻ', 
      bank_account: '', bank_name: '', credit_limit: 0, payment_term: 0
    });
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleEdit = (partner) => {
    setCurrentPartner(partner);
    setFormData({
      type: partner.type, code: partner.code, name: partner.name, company_name: partner.company_name || '', 
      contact_person: partner.contact_person || '', phone: partner.phone || '', email: partner.email || '', 
      tax_code: partner.tax_code || '', address: partner.address || '', category: partner.category || 'Khách lẻ', 
      bank_account: partner.bank_account || '', bank_name: partner.bank_name || '', 
      credit_limit: partner.credit_limit || 0, payment_term: partner.payment_term || 0
    });
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSave = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      const payload = { ...formData, credit_limit: Number(formData.credit_limit), payment_term: Number(formData.payment_term) };
      if (currentPartner) {
        await api.patch(`/partners/${currentPartner.id}`, payload);
      } else {
        delete payload.code; // Bỏ trường code để backend tự sinh
        await api.post('/partners', payload);
      }
      setIsModalOpen(false);
      fetchPartners();
    } catch (err) { alert('Lỗi: ' + (err.response?.data?.error || err.message)); }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Bạn có chắc chắn muốn khóa đối tác này?')) return;
    try {
      await api.delete(`/partners/${id}`);
      fetchPartners();
    } catch (err) { alert('Lỗi: ' + (err.response?.data?.error || err.message)); }
  };

  const columns = [
    { header: 'Mã', accessor: 'code', render: (r) => <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap bg-slate-100 px-2 py-1 rounded">{r.code}</span> },
    { header: 'Tên đối tác', accessor: 'name', render: (r) => (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <div className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${r.type === 'customer' ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600' : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-600'}`}>
          {r.type === 'customer' ? <Users size={18} /> : <Truck size={18} />}
        </div>
        <div>
          <p className="font-bold text-slate-800">{r.name}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">{r.contact_person || 'Chưa có người liên hệ'}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    )},
    { header: 'Loại', accessor: 'type', render: (r) => (<span className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider ${r.type === 'customer' ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200' : 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200'}`}>{r.type === 'customer' ? 'Khách hàng' : 'Nhà cung cấp'}</span>)},
    { header: 'Điện thoại', accessor: 'phone', render: (r) => <span className="text-slate-600">{r.phone || '-'}</span> },
    { header: 'Hạn mức nợ', accessor: 'credit_limit', render: (r) => <span className="font-semibold text-blue-600">{r.credit_limit ? `${Number(r.credit_limit).toLocaleString()} đ` : 'Không có'}</span> },
    { header: 'Thao tác', accessor: 'id', render: (r) => (
      <div className="flex gap-1">
        <button onClick={() => handleEdit(r)} className="text-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-50 p-2 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Sửa"><Edit2 size={16} /></button>
        <button onClick={() => handleDelete(r.id)} className="text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 p-2 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Khóa"><Trash2 size={16} /></button>
      </div>
    )}
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* HEADER */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800">Quản lý Đối tác</h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mt-1">Danh bạ khách hàng và nhà cung cấp của công ty.</p>
        </div>
        <button 
          onClick={handleAddNew} 
          className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-blue-600 text-white px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl hover:bg-blue-700 transition-all shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/20 hover:shadow-blue-600/30 hover:-translate-y-0.5 w-full sm:w-auto"
        >
          <Plus size={18} /> Thêm đối tác
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* BỘ LỌC & TÌM KIẾM */}
      <div className="bg-white p-3 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-4 items-start lg:items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex gap-2 w-full lg:w-auto overflow-x-auto pb-1 lg:pb-0">
          <button onClick={() => setFilterType('all')} className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all ${filterType === 'all' ? 'bg-slate-800 text-white shadow-md' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'}`}>Tất cả</button>
          <button onClick={() => setFilterType('customer')} className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all ${filterType === 'customer' ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-emerald-600/20' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'}`}>Khách hàng</button>
          <button onClick={() => setFilterType('supplier')} className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all ${filterType === 'supplier' ? 'bg-amber-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-amber-600/20' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'}`}>Nhà cung cấp</button>
        </div>
        <div className="relative w-full lg:w-72 shrink-0">
          <Search className="absolute left-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400" size={18} />
          <input type="text" placeholder="Tìm theo tên hoặc mã..." value={search} onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)} className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:bg-white transition-all" />
        </div>
      </div>

      <DataTable columns={columns} data={filteredPartners} loading={loading} />

      {/* MODAL */}
      {isModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4 animate-fade-in">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-[850px] max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden animate-slide-up">
            {/* Header Modal */}
            <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-indigo-600 px-6 py-5 flex justify-between items-center shrink-0">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-xl text-white">{currentPartner ? 'Sửa thông tin đối tác' : 'Thêm đối tác mới'}</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)} className="text-white/70 hover:text-white bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 p-2 rounded-full transition-all"><X size={20} /></button>
            </div>
            
            <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="p-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1 custom-scrollbar">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-5 mb-6">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Phân loại <span className="text-red-500">*</span></label>
                  <select value={formData.type} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, type: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 bg-white transition-all">
                    <option value="customer">Khách hàng</option>
                    <option value="supplier">Nhà cung cấp</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Mã đối tác</label>
                  <div className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-sm text-slate-500 flex items-center gap-2 cursor-not-allowed">
                    <span className="text-slate-400">🔒</span>
                    <span>Hệ thống tự sinh (VD: {formData.type === 'supplier' ? 'NCC001' : 'KH001'})</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Nhóm đối tác</label>

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../api';
import { Calculator, CheckCircle, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';
import DataTable from '../components/DataTable';

export default function Payrolls() {
  const [payrolls, setPayrolls] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [userRole, setUserRole] = useState('');
  
  // Mặc định lấy tháng hiện tại (YYYY-MM)
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState(new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7)); 

  const fetchPayrolls = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const currentUser = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user') || '{}');
      setUserRole(currentUser.role);
      
      const res = await api.get(`/payrolls?period=${period}`);
      
      if (res.data && res.data.data) {
        setPayrolls(res.data.data);
      } else {
        setPayrolls([]);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Lỗi khi load danh sách lương:", err);
      setPayrolls([]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    // Bọc setTimeout để tránh cảnh báo setState đồng bộ trong React 18
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      fetchPayrolls();
    }, 0);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [period]);

  // 1. Tính lương toàn bộ
  const handleGenerateAll = async () => {
    if (!window.confirm(`Hệ thống sẽ tính lương cho TẤT CẢ nhân viên trong kỳ ${period}. Bạn chắc chắn chứ?`)) return;
    try {
      const res = await api.post('/payrolls/generate', { period });
      alert(res.data.message);
      fetchPayrolls();
    } catch (err) {
      alert('Lỗi tính lương: ' + (err.response?.data?.error || err.message));
    }
  };

  // 2. Tính lại riêng 1 người (Dành cho Kế toán)
  const handleGenerateSingle = async (userId, userName) => {
    if (!window.confirm(`Tính lại lương kỳ ${period} cho nhân viên: ${userName}?`)) return;
    try {
      const res = await api.post('/payrolls/generate', { period, user_id: userId });
      alert(res.data.message);
      fetchPayrolls();
    } catch (err) {
      alert('Lỗi: ' + (err.response?.data?.error || err.message));
    }
  };

  // 3. Duyệt lương (Dành cho Giám đốc)
  const handleApprove = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Duyệt bảng lương này? Nhân viên sẽ nhìn thấy tiền lương sau khi duyệt.')) return;
    try {
      await api.post(`/payrolls/${id}/approve`);
      fetchPayrolls();
    } catch (err) {
      alert('Lỗi: ' + (err.response?.data?.error || err.message));
    }
  };

  const columns = [
    { header: 'Nhân viên', accessor: 'full_name', render: (r) => <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 whitespace-nowrap">{r.full_name}</span> },
    { header: 'Kỳ lương', accessor: 'period', render: (r) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{r.period}</span> },
    { header: 'Lương CB', accessor: 'salary_base', render: (r) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{Number(r.salary_base).toLocaleString('vi-VN')} đ</span> },
    { header: 'Lương theo giờ', accessor: 'work_pay', render: (r) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{Math.round(Number(r.work_pay)).toLocaleString('vi-VN')} đ</span> },
    { header: 'Thưởng KPI', accessor: 'kpi_bonus', render: (r) => <span className="text-emerald-600 font-semibold whitespace-nowrap">+{Number(r.kpi_bonus).toLocaleString('vi-VN')} đ</span> },
    { header: 'Khấu trừ (BHXH)', accessor: 'bhxh_deduction', render: (r) => <span className="text-red-500 whitespace-nowrap">-{Math.round(Number(r.bhxh_deduction)).toLocaleString('vi-VN')} đ</span> },
    { header: 'Thực lĩnh', accessor: 'net_salary', render: (r) => <span className="font-extrabold text-blue-600 text-base whitespace-nowrap">{Math.round(Number(r.net_salary)).toLocaleString('vi-VN')} đ</span> },
    { header: 'Trạng thái', accessor: 'status', render: (r) => {
      if (r.status === 'paid') return <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 rounded text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap">Đã trả</span>;
      if (r.status === 'approved') return <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 rounded text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap">Đã duyệt</span>;
      return <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 rounded text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap">Chờ duyệt</span>;
    }},
    { header: 'Thao tác', accessor: 'id', render: (r) => (
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        {/* Nút Duyệt cho GĐ */}
        {r.status === 'draft' && userRole === 'giam_doc' && (
          <button onClick={() => handleApprove(r.id)} className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-100 transition whitespace-nowrap">
            <CheckCircle size={14} /> Duyệt
          </button>
        )}
        {/* Nút tính lại cho Kế toán */}
        {userRole === 'ke_toan' && (
          <button onClick={() => handleGenerateSingle(r.user_id, r.full_name)} className="text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100 p-1.5 rounded" title="Tính lại cho người này">
            <RefreshCw size={16} />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    )}
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* HEADER: Mobile xếp dọc */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800">Bảng lương nhân sự</h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mt-1">Quản lý thu nhập của nhân viên theo kỳ.</p>
        </div>
        
        {/* Cụm điều khiển: Mobile xếp dọc, Desktop xếp ngang */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center gap-3 w-full md:w-auto">
          <input 
            type="month" 
            value={period} 
            onChange={e => setPeriod(e.target.value)} 
            className="px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg bg-white shadow-sm font-medium text-slate-700 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 w-full sm:w-auto"
          />
          
          {['giam_doc', 'ke_toan'].includes(userRole) && (
            <button 
              onClick={handleGenerateAll} 
              className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-blue-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 transition shadow-sm font-semibold w-full sm:w-auto shrink-0"
            >
              <Calculator size={18} /> Tính lương toàn công ty
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* DataTable đã có phân trang */}
      <DataTable columns={columns} data={payrolls} loading={loading} />
      
      {/* Hướng dẫn */}
      <div className="text-sm text-slate-500 bg-amber-50 p-4 rounded-xl border border-amber-100 flex items-start gap-3">
        <div className="bg-amber-200 text-amber-800 p-1 rounded-full mt-0.5 shrink-0">💡</div>
        <div>
          <p><b>Hướng dẫn:</b></p>
          <p>- Chọn kỳ lương (Ví dụ: Tháng 11/2026).</p>
          <p>- Bấm <b>"Tính lương toàn công ty"</b> để hệ thống tự động quét Chấm công + KPI và tính ra tiền.</p>
          <p>- Giám đốc bấm <b>"Duyệt"</b> để chốt bảng lương.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../api';
import { Plus, X } from 'lucide-react';
import DataTable from '../components/DataTable';

export default function ShiftReports() {
  const [reports, setReports] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    day: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), shift: 'morning', good_qty: 0, scrap_qty: 0, downtime_min: 0, qc_result: 'pass'
  });

  const fetchReports = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    api.get('/shift-reports').then(res => setReports(res.data.data)).catch(console.error).finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  useEffect(() => { const timer = setTimeout(() => { fetchReports(); }, 0); return () => clearTimeout(timer); }, []);

  const handleSave = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      await api.post('/shift-reports', formData);
      alert('Báo cáo ca thành công!'); setIsModalOpen(false); fetchReports();
    } catch (err) { alert('Lỗi: ' + (err.response?.data?.error || err.message)); }
  };

  const columns = [
    { header: 'Ngày', accessor: 'day', render: (r) => new Date(r.day).toLocaleDateString('vi-VN') },
    { header: 'Ca', accessor: 'shift', render: (r) => { const s = { morning: 'Sáng', afternoon: 'Chiều', night: 'Đêm' }; return <span className="font-semibold">{s[r.shift] || r.shift}</span>; } },
    { header: 'Đạt (m²)', accessor: 'good_qty', render: (r) => <span className="text-emerald-600 font-bold">{r.good_qty}</span> },
    { header: 'Phế (m²)', accessor: 'scrap_qty', render: (r) => <span className="text-red-500">{r.scrap_qty}</span> },
    { header: 'Dừng máy', accessor: 'downtime_min', render: (r) => `${r.downtime_min} phút` },
    { header: 'QC', accessor: 'qc_result', render: (r) => r.qc_result === 'pass' ? <span className="text-emerald-600 font-bold">Đạt</span> : <span className="text-red-600 font-bold">Lỗi</span> },
    { header: 'Người BC', accessor: 'creator_name' }
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4">

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../api';
import { Plus, X, BookOpen, Search, CheckCircle, Tag } from 'lucide-react';
import DataTable from '../components/DataTable';

export default function SOP() {
  const [sops, setSops] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  
  // State Modal Thêm quy trình
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    code: '', title: '', steps: '', owner: '', tags: ''
  });

  const fetchSOPs = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    api.get('/sop')
      .then(res => setSops(res.data.data))
      .catch(err => console.error(err))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    // Bọc setTimeout để tránh cảnh báo setState đồng bộ trong React 18
    const timer = setTimeout(() => { fetchSOPs(); }, 0);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);

  const handleSave = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      await api.post('/sop', formData);
      setIsModalOpen(false);
      fetchSOPs();
    } catch (err) {
      alert('Lỗi: ' + (err.response?.data?.error || err.message));
    }
  };

  // Lọc theo thanh tìm kiếm
  const filteredSOPs = sops.filter(sop => 
    sop.title.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) || 
    sop.code.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
    (sop.tags && sop.tags.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()))
  );

  const columns = [
    { header: 'Mã quy trình', accessor: 'code', render: (r) => <span className="font-bold text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 px-2 py-1 rounded whitespace-nowrap">{r.code}</span> },
    { header: 'Tiêu đề quy trình', accessor: 'title', render: (r) => (
      <div className="min-w-[220px] max-w-[320px]">
        <p className="font-bold text-slate-800">{r.title}</p>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1 line-clamp-1">{r.steps}</p>
      </div>
    )},
    { header: 'Người/Bộ phận phụ trách', accessor: 'owner', render: (r) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{r.owner || '-'}</span> },
    { header: 'Thẻ (Tags)', accessor: 'tags', render: (r) => (
      <div className="flex gap-1 flex-wrap min-w-[120px]">
        {r.tags ? r.tags.split(',').map((tag, idx) => (
          <span key={idx} className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full whitespace-nowrap">
            <Tag size={10} /> {tag.trim()}
          </span>
        )) : '-'}
      </div>
    )},
    { header: 'Trạng thái', accessor: 'approved', render: (r) => (
      r.approved 
        ? <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-600 text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap"><CheckCircle size={14}/> Đã duyệt</span>
        : <span className="text-amber-600 text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap">Chờ duyệt</span>
    )}
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* HEADER: Mobile xếp dọc */}
      <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row justify-between items-start lg:items-center gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
            <BookOpen className="text-blue-600 shrink-0" /> Thư viện Quy trình (SOP)
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mt-1">Tài liệu hướng dẫn vận hành dành cho nhân viên và Trợ lý AI.</p>
        </div>
        
        {/* Cụm tìm kiếm + nút: Mobile xếp dọc */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center gap-3 w-full lg:w-auto">
          <div className="relative w-full lg:w-64 shrink-0">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400" size={18} />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Tìm mã, tên, tag..."
              value={search}
              onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 shadow-sm"
            />
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => { setFormData({ code: '', title: '', steps: '', owner: '', tags: '' }); setIsModalOpen(true); }}
            className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-blue-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 transition shadow-sm whitespace-nowrap w-full sm:w-auto shrink-0"
          >
            <Plus size={18} /> Thêm quy trình
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Bảng dữ liệu */}
      <DataTable columns={columns} data={filteredSOPs} loading={loading} />

      {/* Modal Thêm Quy trình */}
      {isModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4">
          {/* Modal: Mobile full width trừ lề, Desktop 600px */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-[600px] max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
            <div className="bg-slate-50 px-4 sm:px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex justify-between items-center sticky top-0 z-10 shrink-0">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-lg text-slate-800">Thêm Quy trình mới</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-red-500 p-1"><X size={20} /></button>
            </div>
            
            <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="p-4 sm:p-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1 space-y-4">
              {/* Grid: Mobile 1 cột, Desktop 2 cột */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">Mã quy trình *</label>
                  <input required type="text" value={formData.code} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, code: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" placeholder="VD: SOP-QC-01" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">Bộ phận phụ trách</label>
                  <input type="text" value={formData.owner} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, owner: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" placeholder="VD: Tổ QC, Kho..." />
                </div>
              </div>
              
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">Tiêu đề quy trình *</label>
                <input required type="text" value={formData.title} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, title: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" placeholder="VD: Quy trình kiểm tra chất lượng thảm 10mm" />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">Nội dung các bước *</label>
                <textarea required rows="5" value={formData.steps} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, steps: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" placeholder="Bước 1: ...&#10;Bước 2: ...&#10;Bước 3: ..."></textarea>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">Thẻ tìm kiếm (Tags)</label>
                <input type="text" value={formData.tags} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, tags: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" placeholder="VD: qc, tham-10mm, kiem-tra (Cách nhau bởi dấu phẩy)" />
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">Mẹo: Thêm tags để AI dễ dàng tìm thấy quy trình này khi nhân viên đặt câu hỏi.</p>
              </div>

              {/* Nút bấm: Mobile xếp dọc */}
              <div className="pt-4 flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row justify-end gap-3 border-t">
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)} className="px-4 py-2 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-lg w-full sm:w-auto">Hủy</button>
                <button type="submit" className="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 shadow-md w-full sm:w-auto">Lưu quy trình</button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../api';
import { ArrowDownToLine, ArrowUpFromLine, RefreshCw, Search } from 'lucide-react';
import DataTable from '../components/DataTable';

export default function Stock() {
  const [ledger, setLedger] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');

  const fetchStock = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    api.get('/stock-ledger')
      .then(res => setLedger(res.data.data))
      .catch(err => console.error(err))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    // Bọc setTimeout để tránh cảnh báo setState đồng bộ trong React 18
    const timer = setTimeout(() => { fetchStock(); }, 0);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);

  const filteredLedger = ledger.filter(row => 
    (row.item_name && row.item_name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())) ||
    (row.item_code && row.item_code.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()))
  );

  const columns = [
    { 
      header: 'Thời gian', 
      accessor: 'created_at', 
      render: (r) => (
        <span className="text-slate-600 text-sm whitespace-nowrap">
          {new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleString('vi-VN')}
        </span>
      )
    },
    { 
      header: 'Mã hàng', 
      accessor: 'item_code', 
      render: (r) => <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap">{r.item_code}</span> 
    },
    { 
      header: 'Tên hàng hóa', 
      accessor: 'item_name', 
      render: (r) => <span className="font-medium text-slate-800 min-w-[180px] block">{r.item_name}</span> 
    },
    { 
      header: 'Loại giao dịch', 
      accessor: 'type',

        if (r.type === 'out') return <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-red-600 bg-red-50 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-bold w-max whitespace-nowrap"><ArrowUpFromLine size={14}/> Xuất kho</span>;
        return <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-bold w-max whitespace-nowrap"><RefreshCw size={14}/> Điều chỉnh</span>;
      }
    },
    { 
      header: 'Số lượng', 
      accessor: 'qty', 
      render: (r) => (
        <span className={`font-bold whitespace-nowrap ${r.type === 'in' ? 'text-emerald-600' : 'text-red-600'}`}>
          {r.type === 'in' ? '+' : '-'}{Number(r.qty).toLocaleString('vi-VN')}
        </span>
      )
    },
    { 
      header: 'Nguồn gốc', 
      accessor: 'ref_type', 
      render: (r) => {
        if (r.ref_type === 'order') return <span className="text-sm text-slate-500 whitespace-nowrap">Từ Đơn hàng (ID: {r.ref_id})</span>;
        if (r.ref_type === 'work_order') return <span className="text-sm text-slate-500 whitespace-nowrap">Từ Sản xuất</span>;
        if (r.ref_type === 'initial') return <span className="text-sm text-slate-500 italic whitespace-nowrap">Tồn kho ban đầu</span>;
        return <span className="text-sm text-slate-500 whitespace-nowrap">Nhập tay</span>;
      }
    }
  ];

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../api';
import { Plus, X, Upload, AlertTriangle, Target, TrendingUp } from 'lucide-react';
import DataTable from '../components/DataTable';

export default function Tasks() {
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState([]);
  const [users, setUsers] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [userRole, setUserRole] = useState('');
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState('month');
  
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({ 
    title: '', assignee_id: '', task_type: 'kpi', kpi_weight: 10, revenue_value: 0, start_date: '', due: '' 
  });

  const [isEvidenceOpen, setIsEvidenceOpen] = useState(false);
  const [currentTaskId, setCurrentTaskId] = useState(null);
  const [evidenceText, setEvidenceText] = useState('');

  const fetchData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const currentUser = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user') || '{}');
      setUserRole(currentUser.role);
      
      const resTasks = await api.get(`/tasks?period=${period}`);
      setTasks(resTasks.data.data);
      
      if (['giam_doc', 'ke_toan', 'to_truong'].includes(currentUser.role)) {
        try { 
          const resUsers = await api.get('/users'); 
          setUsers(resUsers.data); 
        } catch {
          console.log("Không có quyền lấy danh sách users");
        }
      }
    } catch (err) { 
      console.error(err); 
    } finally { 
      setLoading(false); 
    }
  };

  // Bọc trong setTimeout để tránh lỗi setState đồng bộ trong useEffect
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      fetchData();
    }, 0);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [period]);

  const handleAssignTask = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      const payload = { 
        ...formData, 
        assignee_id: Number(formData.assignee_id), 
        kpi_weight: formData.task_type === 'kpi' ? Number(formData.kpi_weight) : 0, 
        revenue_value: formData.task_type === 'revenue' ? Number(formData.revenue_value) : 0,
        start_date: formData.start_date === '' ? null : formData.start_date
      };
      await api.post('/tasks', payload);
      setIsModalOpen(false);
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) { 
      alert('Lỗi: ' + (err.response?.data?.error || err.message)); 
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitEvidence = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!evidenceText.trim()) return alert('Vui lòng nhập bằng chứng');
    try {
      await api.patch(`/tasks/${currentTaskId}`, { status: 'done', evidence: evidenceText });
      setIsEvidenceOpen(false);
      setEvidenceText('');
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) { 
      alert('Lỗi: ' + (err.response?.data?.error || err.message)); 
    }
  };

  const getStatusBadge = (status, dueDate) => {
    const isLate = new Date(dueDate) < new Date() && status !== 'done';
    if (status === 'done') return <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 rounded-md text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap">Hoàn thành</span>;
    if (isLate) return <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-red-100 text-red-700 rounded-md text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 whitespace-nowrap"><AlertTriangle size={12}/> Trễ hạn</span>;
    if (status === 'doing') return <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 rounded-md text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap">Đang làm</span>;
    return <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 rounded-md text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap">Chờ làm</span>;
  };

  const columns = [
    { header: 'Công việc', accessor: 'title', render: (r) => <span className="font-medium text-slate-800 min-w-[200px] block">{r.title}</span> },
    { header: 'Người nhận', accessor: 'assignee_name', render: (r) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{r.assignee_name || `ID: ${r.assignee_id}`}</span> },
    { header: 'Loại', accessor: 'task_type', render: (r) => <span className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap ${r.task_type === 'revenue' ? 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600'}`}>{r.task_type === 'revenue' ? `Doanh thu: ${Number(r.revenue_value).toLocaleString()} đ` : `KPI (x${r.kpi_weight})`}</span> },
    { header: 'Hạn chót', accessor: 'due', render: (r) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{new Date(r.due).toLocaleDateString('vi-VN')}</span> },
    { header: 'Trạng thái', accessor: 'status', render: (r) => getStatusBadge(r.status, r.due) },
    { header: 'Thao tác', accessor: 'id', render: (r) => (
      r.status !== 'done' ? <button onClick={() => { setCurrentTaskId(r.id); setIsEvidenceOpen(true); }} className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-100 whitespace-nowrap"><Upload size={14}/> Báo cáo</button> : null
    )}
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* HEADER: Mobile xếp dọc */}
      <div className="flex flex-col xl:flex-row justify-between items-start xl:items-center gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800">Công việc & KPI</h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mt-1">Quản lý công việc và đánh giá năng suất.</p>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center gap-3 w-full xl:w-auto">
          {/* Bộ lọc thời gian: cuộn ngang trên mobile */}
          <div className="w-full sm:w-auto overflow-x-auto pb-1 sm:pb-0">
            <div className="flex bg-slate-100 p-1 rounded-xl w-max">
              {[
                { key: 'day', label: 'Hôm nay' }, { key: 'week', label: 'Tuần này' },
                { key: 'month', label: 'Tháng này' }, { key: 'quarter', label: 'Quý này' }, { key: 'year', label: 'Năm nay' }
              ].map(p => (
                <button key={p.key} onClick={() => setPeriod(p.key)} className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium rounded-lg transition-all whitespace-nowrap ${period === p.key ? 'bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700'}`}>{p.label}</button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {['giam_doc', 'ke_toan', 'to_truong'].includes(userRole) && (
            <button 
              onClick={() => { setFormData({ title: '', assignee_id: '', task_type: 'kpi', kpi_weight: 10, revenue_value: 0, start_date: '', due: '' }); setIsModalOpen(true); }} 
              className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-blue-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 transition w-full sm:w-auto shrink-0"
            >
              <Plus size={18} /> Giao việc mới
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <DataTable columns={columns} data={tasks} loading={loading} />

      {/* Modal Giao việc thông minh */}
      {isModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-[550px] max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
            <div className="bg-slate-50 px-4 sm:px-6 py-4 border-b flex justify-between items-center sticky top-0 z-10 shrink-0">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-lg text-slate-800">Giao việc mới</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-red-500 p-1"><X size={20} /></button>
            </div>
            
            <form onSubmit={handleAssignTask} className="p-4 sm:p-6 space-y-5 overflow-y-auto flex-1">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">Tên công việc *</label>
                <input required type="text" value={formData.title} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, title: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" placeholder="VD: Kiểm tra máy dệt, Thu nợ khách hàng..." />
              </div>

              {/* Form 3 cột trên desktop, 1 cột mobile */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">Người nhận *</label>
                  <select required value={formData.assignee_id} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, assignee_id: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500">
                    <option value="">-- Chọn --</option>
                    {users.filter(u => u.role !== 'giam_doc').map(u => <option key={u.id} value={u.id}>{u.full_name}</option>)}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">Ngày bắt đầu</label>
                  <input type="date" value={formData.start_date} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, start_date: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">Hạn chót *</label>
                  <input required type="date" value={formData.due} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, due: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="bg-blue-50 p-3 sm:p-4 rounded-xl border border-blue-100">
                <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-blue-800 mb-3">Sếp muốn giao loại việc gì?</label>
                {/* Radio cards: 1 cột mobile, 2 cột desktop */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:gap-4">
                  <label className={`flex flex-col p-3 rounded-lg border-2 cursor-pointer transition-all ${formData.task_type === 'kpi' ? 'border-blue-500 bg-white shadow-sm' : 'border-transparent hover:bg-blue-100'}`}>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                      <input type="radio" name="task_type" value="kpi" checked={formData.task_type === 'kpi'} onChange={() => setFormData({...formData, task_type: 'kpi'})} className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm flex items-center gap-1"><Target size={14}/> Việc tính KPI</span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 ml-6">Đánh giá năng suất, tính lương thưởng.</p>
                  </label>

                  <label className={`flex flex-col p-3 rounded-lg border-2 cursor-pointer transition-all ${formData.task_type === 'revenue' ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-white shadow-sm' : 'border-transparent hover:bg-blue-100'}`}>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                      <input type="radio" name="task_type" value="revenue" checked={formData.task_type === 'revenue'} onChange={() => setFormData({...formData, task_type: 'revenue'})} className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm flex items-center gap-1"><TrendingUp size={14}/> Việc mang lại tiền</span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 ml-6">Thu nợ, chốt đơn, mang về doanh thu.</p>
                  </label>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-blue-200">
                  {formData.task_type === 'kpi' ? (
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">Mức độ quan trọng (Trọng số) *</label>
                      <select required value={formData.kpi_weight} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, kpi_weight: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-blue-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 bg-white">
                        <option value="1">1 - Việc phụ, không quan trọng</option>
                        <option value="5">5 - Việc bình thường</option>
                        <option value="10">10 - Việc quan trọng</option>
                        <option value="20">20 - Việc cực kỳ quan trọng</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">Số tiền dự kiến mang lại (VNĐ) *</label>
                      <input required type="number" min="0" step="100000" value={formData.revenue_value} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, revenue_value: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-emerald-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 bg-white font-bold text-emerald-600" placeholder="VD: 50000000" />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Nút: mobile xếp dọc */}
              <div className="pt-4 flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row justify-end gap-3 border-t">
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)} className="px-4 py-2 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-lg w-full sm:w-auto">Hủy</button>
                <button type="submit" className="px-6 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 shadow-md font-bold w-full sm:w-auto">Giao việc</button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Modal Báo cáo */}
      {isEvidenceOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-[450px] max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
            <div className="bg-slate-50 px-4 sm:px-6 py-4 border-b flex justify-between items-center sticky top-0 z-10 shrink-0">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-lg">Báo cáo hoàn thành</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setIsEvidenceOpen(false)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-red-500 p-1"><X size={20} /></button>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmitEvidence} className="p-4 sm:p-6 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto flex-1">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-1">Bằng chứng *</label>
                <textarea required rows="4" value={evidenceText} onChange={e => setEvidenceText(e.target.value)} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" placeholder="Nhập ghi chú hoặc link ảnh..."></textarea>
              </div>
              <div className="pt-4 flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row justify-end gap-3 border-t">
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setIsEvidenceOpen(false)} className="px-4 py-2 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-lg w-full sm:w-auto">Hủy</button>
                <button type="submit" className="px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-emerald-700 w-full sm:w-auto">Gửi</button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
