import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import api from '../api';
import { Plus, Edit2, X, Key, Trash2, User, MapPin, Briefcase } from 'lucide-react';
import DataTable from '../components/DataTable';

export default function Users() {
  const [users, setUsers] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState(null);

  // STATE FULL 25 TRƯỜNG
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    username: '', password: '', role: 'cong_nhan', status: 'active',
    full_name: '', dob: '', gender: 'male', cccd: '', cccd_date: '', cccd_place: '',
    phone: '', email: '', permanent_address: '', current_address: '', emergency_contact: '',
    team_id: '', position: '', join_date: '', contract_type: 'official',
    salary_base: 0, bank_account: '', bank_name: '', tax_code: '', bhxh_code: ''
  });

  const fetchUsers = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    api.get('/users')
      .then(res => setUsers(res.data))
      .catch(err => console.error(err))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    // Bọc setTimeout để tránh cảnh báo setState đồng bộ trong React 18
    const timer = setTimeout(() => { fetchUsers(); }, 0);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);

  const handleAddNew = () => {
    setCurrentUser(null);
    setFormData({
      username: '', password: '123', role: 'cong_nhan', status: 'active',
      full_name: '', dob: '', gender: 'male', cccd: '', cccd_date: '', cccd_place: '',
      phone: '', email: '', permanent_address: '', current_address: '', emergency_contact: '',
      team_id: '', position: '', join_date: '', contract_type: 'official',
      salary_base: 0, bank_account: '', bank_name: '', tax_code: '', bhxh_code: ''
    });
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleEdit = (user) => {
    setCurrentUser(user);
    setFormData({
      username: user.username, password: '', role: user.role, status: user.status,
      full_name: user.full_name, 
      dob: user.dob ? user.dob.slice(0, 10) : '', 
      gender: user.gender || 'male', 
      cccd: user.cccd || '', 
      cccd_date: user.cccd_date ? user.cccd_date.slice(0, 10) : '', 
      cccd_place: user.cccd_place || '',
      phone: user.phone || '', email: user.email || '', permanent_address: user.permanent_address || '', 
      current_address: user.current_address || '', emergency_contact: user.emergency_contact || '',
      team_id: user.team_id || '', position: user.position || '', 
      join_date: user.join_date ? user.join_date.slice(0, 10) : '', 
      contract_type: user.contract_type || 'official',
      salary_base: user.salary_base || 0, bank_account: user.bank_account || '', bank_name: user.bank_name || '', 
      tax_code: user.tax_code || '', bhxh_code: user.bxhx_code || ''
    });
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSave = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      const cleanData = { ...formData };
      const nullableFields = ['dob', 'cccd_date', 'join_date'];
      nullableFields.forEach(f => { if (cleanData[f] === '') cleanData[f] = null; });

      if (currentUser) {
        delete cleanData.password;
        await api.patch(`/users/${currentUser.id}`, cleanData);
        alert('Cập nhật thành công!');
      } else {
        await api.post('/users', cleanData);
        alert('Tạo tài khoản thành công!');
      }
      setIsModalOpen(false);
      fetchUsers();
    } catch (err) {
      alert('Lỗi: ' + (err.response?.data?.error || err.message));
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Bạn có chắc chắn muốn cho nhân viên này nghỉ việc?')) return;
    try {
      await api.delete(`/users/${id}`);
      fetchUsers();
    } catch (err) { alert('Lỗi: ' + (err.response?.data?.error || err.message)); }
  };

  const handleResetPassword = async (id, username) => {
    const newPass = window.prompt(`Nhập mật khẩu mới cho tài khoản "${username}":`, '123456');
    if (!newPass) return;
    try {
      await api.patch(`/users/${id}/reset-password`, { new_password: newPass });
      alert('Đã cấp lại mật khẩu thành công!');
    } catch (err) { alert('Lỗi: ' + (err.response?.data?.error || err.message)); }
  };

  const columns = [
    { header: 'Tên đăng nhập', accessor: 'username', render: (r) => <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 whitespace-nowrap">{r.username}</span> },
    { header: 'Họ và tên', accessor: 'full_name', render: (r) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{r.full_name}</span> },
    { header: 'Chức vụ', accessor: 'position', render: (r) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{r.position || '-'}</span> },
    { header: 'Phân quyền', accessor: 'role', render: (r) => {
      const roleMap = {
        giam_doc: { label: 'Giám đốc', color: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700' },
        ke_toan: { label: 'Kế toán', color: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700' },
        to_truong: { label: 'Tổ trưởng', color: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700' },
        cong_nhan: { label: 'Công nhân', color: 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700' },
        ctv: { label: 'CTV', color: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700' },
      };
      const info = roleMap[r.role] || { label: r.role, color: 'bg-gray-100' };
      return <span className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap ${info.color}`}>{info.label}</span>;
    }},
    { header: 'SĐT', accessor: 'phone', render: (r) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{r.phone || '-'}</span> },
    { header: 'Lương cơ bản', accessor: 'salary_base', render: (r) => <span className="font-semibold text-emerald-600 whitespace-nowrap">{Number(r.salary_base).toLocaleString('vi-VN')} đ</span> },
    { header: 'Thao tác', accessor: 'id', render: (r) => (
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <button onClick={() => handleEdit(r)} className="text-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-50 p-1.5 rounded" title="Sửa"><Edit2 size={16} /></button>
        <button onClick={() => handleResetPassword(r.id, r.username)} className="text-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-50 p-1.5 rounded" title="Cấp lại mật khẩu"><Key size={16} /></button>
        <button onClick={() => handleDelete(r.id)} className="text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 p-1.5 rounded" title="Cho nghỉ việc"><Trash2 size={16} /></button>
      </div>
    )}
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* HEADER: Mobile xếp dọc */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800">Quản lý Nhân sự</h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mt-1">Hồ sơ nhân sự đầy đủ 25 trường thông tin.</p>
        </div>
        <button 
          onClick={handleAddNew} 
          className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-blue-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 transition shadow-sm w-full sm:w-auto shrink-0"
        >
          <Plus size={18} /> Thêm nhân sự
        </button>
      </div>

      <DataTable columns={columns} data={users} loading={loading} />

      {/* Modal Full Trường (Dạng cuộn dọc) */}
      {isModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-[800px] max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
            <div className="bg-slate-50 px-4 sm:px-6 py-4 border-b flex justify-between items-center sticky top-0 z-10 shrink-0">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-lg text-slate-800">{currentUser ? 'Sửa hồ sơ nhân sự' : 'Thêm nhân sự mới'}</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-red-500 p-1"><X size={20} /></button>
            </div>
            
            <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="p-4 sm:p-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1">
              
              {/* PHẦN 1: TÀI KHOẢN */}
              <h4 className="font-bold text-blue-600 flex items-center gap-2 mb-3 border-b pb-2"><User size={18}/> 1. Thông tin Tài khoản & Phân quyền</h4>
              {/* Grid: Mobile 1 cột, Tablet 2 cột, Desktop 4 cột */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6">
                <div><label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-1">Tên đăng nhập *</label><input required type="text" value={formData.username} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, username: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg disabled:bg-slate-100 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" disabled={!!currentUser} /></div>
                <div><label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-1">Mật khẩu {currentUser ? '' : '*'}</label><input required={!currentUser} type="text" value={formData.password} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, password: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" placeholder={currentUser ? "Bỏ trống để giữ nguyên" : ""} /></div>
                <div><label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-1">Phân quyền *</label><select required value={formData.role} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, role: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"><option value="giam_doc">Giám đốc</option><option value="ke_toan">Kế toán</option><option value="to_truong">Tổ trưởng</option><option value="cong_nhan">Công nhân</option><option value="ctv">CTV</option></select></div>
                <div><label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-1">Trạng thái</label><select value={formData.status} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, status: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"><option value="active">Đang làm việc</option><option value="suspended">Tạm đình chỉ</option></select></div>
              </div>

              {/* PHẦN 2: CÁ NHÂN */}
              <h4 className="font-bold text-blue-600 flex items-center gap-2 mb-3 border-b pb-2"><MapPin size={18}/> 2. Thông tin Cá nhân (Hồ sơ)</h4>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6">
                <div className="sm:col-span-2"><label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-1">Họ và tên *</label><input required type="text" value={formData.full_name} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, full_name: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" /></div>
                <div><label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-1">Ngày sinh</label><input type="date" value={formData.dob} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, dob: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" /></div>
                <div><label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-1">Giới tính</label><select value={formData.gender} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, gender: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"><option value="male">Nam</option><option value="female">Nữ</option><option value="other">Khác</option></select></div>
                
                <div><label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-1">Số CCCD</label><input type="text" value={formData.cccd} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, cccd: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" /></div>
                <div><label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-1">Ngày cấp</label><input type="date" value={formData.cccd_date} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, cccd_date: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" /></div>
                <div className="sm:col-span-2"><label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-1">Nơi cấp</label><input type="text" value={formData.cccd_place} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, cccd_place: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" /></div>

                <div><label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-1">Số điện thoại</label><input type="text" value={formData.phone} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, phone: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" /></div>
                <div className="sm:col-span-2 md:col-span-3"><label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-1">Email</label><input type="email" value={formData.email} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, email: e.target.value})} className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500" /></div>

$dbContent = @'
const mysql = require("mysql2/promise");
require("dotenv").config();

const pool = mysql.createPool({
  host: process.env.DB_HOST || "localhost",
  user: process.env.DB_USER || "root",
  password: process.env.DB_PASSWORD || "",
  database: process.env.DB_NAME || "sunny_ai",
  waitForConnections: true,
  connectionLimit: 10,
  queueLimit: 0
});

async function initDatabase() {
  const conn = await pool.getConnection();
  try {
    // ---- Existing tables (IF NOT EXISTS - se bo qua neu da co) ----
    await conn.query(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
        id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
        username VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
        full_name VARCHAR(100),
        email VARCHAR(100),
        role ENUM('ADMIN','MANAGER','SALES','WAREHOUSE','ACCOUNTANT') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SALES',
        status TINYINT DEFAULT 1,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
    `);

    await conn.query(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners (
        id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
        partner_code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        partner_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
        partner_type ENUM('CUSTOMER','SUPPLIER') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CUSTOMER',
        phone VARCHAR(30),
        email VARCHAR(100),
        address TEXT,
        notes TEXT,
        status TINYINT DEFAULT 1,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
    `);

    await conn.query(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (
        id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
        item_code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        item_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
        item_type ENUM('MATERIAL','PRODUCT') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PRODUCT',
        unit VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pcs',
        cost_price DECIMAL(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
        sell_price DECIMAL(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
        stock_quantity DECIMAL(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
        min_stock DECIMAL(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
        notes TEXT,
        status TINYINT DEFAULT 1,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
    `);

    await conn.query(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_logs (
        id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
        user_id INT,
        action VARCHAR(50),
        table_name VARCHAR(50),
        record_id INT,
        before_json LONGTEXT,
        after_json LONGTEXT,
        ip_address VARCHAR(50),
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
    `);

    // ============ DAY 3: NEW TABLES ============
    await conn.query(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
        id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
        order_code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        partner_id INT NOT NULL,
        order_type ENUM('SALES','PURCHASE') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SALES',
        order_date DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        status ENUM('DRAFT','CONFIRMED','DELIVERED','CANCELLED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
        total_amount DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        notes TEXT,
        created_by INT,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        INDEX idx_orders_partner (partner_id),
        INDEX idx_orders_status (status)
      ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
    `);

    await conn.query(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS order_items (
        id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
        order_id INT NOT NULL,
        item_id INT NOT NULL,
        quantity DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        unit_price DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        total_price DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        notes TEXT,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        INDEX idx_oi_order (order_id),
        INDEX idx_oi_item (item_id),
        CONSTRAINT fk_oi_order FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
    `);

    await conn.query(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_ledger (
        id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
        item_id INT NOT NULL,
        transaction_type ENUM('IN','OUT','ADJUST') NOT NULL,
        reference_type VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'MANUAL',
        reference_id INT,
        quantity DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL,
        balance_before DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        balance_after DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        unit_cost DECIMAL(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
        notes TEXT,
        created_by INT,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        INDEX idx_sl_item (item_id),
        INDEX idx_sl_ref (reference_type, reference_id),
        INDEX idx_sl_type (transaction_type)
      ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
    `);

    console.log("[DB] All tables ready");
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[DB] Init error:", err.message);
    throw err;
  } finally {
    conn.release();
  }
}

module.exports = { pool, initDatabase };

$orderModel = @'
const { pool } = require("../config/db");

class Order {
  static async findAll({ status, order_type, partner_id, keyword, limit = 100, offset = 0 } = {}) {
    let sql = `SELECT o.*, p.partner_name, u.full_name AS creator_name
               FROM orders o
               LEFT JOIN partners p ON p.id = o.partner_id
               LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.created_by
               WHERE 1=1`;
    const params = [];
    if (status) { sql += " AND o.status = ?"; params.push(status); }
    if (order_type) { sql += " AND o.order_type = ?"; params.push(order_type); }
    if (partner_id) { sql += " AND o.partner_id = ?"; params.push(partner_id); }
    if (keyword) { sql += " AND o.order_code LIKE ?"; params.push(`%${keyword}%`); }
    sql += " ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?";
    params.push(Number(limit), Number(offset));
    const [rows] = await pool.query(sql, params);
    return rows;
  }

  static async findById(id) {
    const [rows] = await pool.query(
      `SELECT o.*, p.partner_name, u.full_name AS creator_name
       FROM orders o
       LEFT JOIN partners p ON p.id = o.partner_id
       LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.created_by
       WHERE o.id = ?`, [id]
    );
    return rows[0] || null;
  }

  static async getItems(orderId) {
    const [rows] = await pool.query(
      `SELECT oi.*, i.item_code, i.item_name, i.unit
       FROM order_items oi
       JOIN items i ON i.id = oi.item_id
       WHERE oi.order_id = ?
       ORDER BY oi.id`, [orderId]
    );
    return rows;
  }

  static async create(data, conn = null) {
    const exec = conn || pool;
    const [result] = await exec.query(
      `INSERT INTO orders
         (order_code, partner_id, order_type, order_date, status, total_amount, notes, created_by)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
      [
        data.order_code,
        data.partner_id,
        data.order_type || "SALES",
        data.order_date || new Date(),
        data.status || "DRAFT",
        data.total_amount || 0,
        data.notes || null,
        data.created_by || null
      ]
    );
    return result.insertId;
  }

  static async update(id, data) {
    const fields = [];
    const params = [];
    const allowed = ["order_code", "partner_id", "order_type", "order_date", "status", "total_amount", "notes"];
    for (const k of allowed) {
      if (data[k] !== undefined) { fields.push(`${k} = ?`); params.push(data[k]); }
    }
    if (fields.length === 0) return false;
    params.push(id);
    const [r] = await pool.query(`UPDATE orders SET ${fields.join(", ")} WHERE id = ?`, params);
    return r.affectedRows > 0;
  }

  static async remove(id) {
    const [r] = await pool.query("DELETE FROM orders WHERE id = ?", [id]);
    return r.affectedRows > 0;
  }

  static async recalcTotal(orderId, conn = null) {
    const exec = conn || pool;
    const [rows] = await exec.query(
      "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_price),0) AS total FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?",
      [orderId]
    );
    const total = Number(rows[0].total);
    await exec.query("UPDATE orders SET total_amount = ? WHERE id = ?", [total, orderId]);
    return total;
  }

  static async generateCode(type = "SALES") {
    const prefix = type === "PURCHASE" ? "PO" : "SO";
    const [rows] = await pool.query(
      "SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM orders WHERE order_code LIKE ?", [`${prefix}-%`]
    );
    const next = Number(rows[0].c) + 1;
    return `${prefix}-${String(next).padStart(5, "0")}`;
  }
}

module.exports = Order;
'@

$orderItemModel = @'
const { pool } = require("../config/db");
const Order = require("./Order");

class OrderItem {
  static async findAll({ order_id, item_id, limit = 200, offset = 0 } = {}) {
    let sql = `SELECT oi.*, i.item_code, i.item_name, i.unit, o.order_code
               FROM order_items oi
               JOIN items i ON i.id = oi.item_id
               JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
               WHERE 1=1`;
    const params = [];
    if (order_id) { sql += " AND oi.order_id = ?"; params.push(order_id); }
    if (item_id)  { sql += " AND oi.item_id = ?";  params.push(item_id); }
    sql += " ORDER BY oi.id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?";
    params.push(Number(limit), Number(offset));
    const [rows] = await pool.query(sql, params);
    return rows;
  }

  static async findById(id) {
    const [rows] = await pool.query(
      `SELECT oi.*, i.item_code, i.item_name
       FROM order_items oi
       JOIN items i ON i.id = oi.item_id
       WHERE oi.id = ?`, [id]
    );
    return rows[0] || null;
  }

  static async create(data) {
    const total = Number(data.quantity) * Number(data.unit_price);
    const [result] = await pool.query(
      `INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, item_id, quantity, unit_price, total_price, notes)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
      [data.order_id, data.item_id, data.quantity, data.unit_price, total, data.notes || null]
    );
    await Order.recalcTotal(data.order_id);
    return result.insertId;
  }

  static async update(id, data) {
    const existing = await this.findById(id);
    if (!existing) return false;
    const q = data.quantity !== undefined ? data.quantity : existing.quantity;
    const p = data.unit_price !== undefined ? data.unit_price : existing.unit_price;
    const total = Number(q) * Number(p);

    const fields = [];
    const params = [];
    if (data.quantity !== undefined)   { fields.push("quantity = ?");   params.push(data.quantity); }
    if (data.unit_price !== undefined) { fields.push("unit_price = ?"); params.push(data.unit_price); }
    if (data.notes !== undefined)      { fields.push("notes = ?");      params.push(data.notes); }
    fields.push("total_price = ?");    params.push(total);
    params.push(id);
    await pool.query(`UPDATE order_items SET ${fields.join(", ")} WHERE id = ?`, params);
    await Order.recalcTotal(existing.order_id);
    return true;
  }

  static async remove(id) {
    const existing = await this.findById(id);
    if (!existing) return false;
    await pool.query("DELETE FROM order_items WHERE id = ?", [id]);
    await Order.recalcTotal(existing.order_id);
    return true;
  }
}

module.exports = OrderItem;

$stockLedgerModel = @'
const { pool } = require("../config/db");

class StockLedger {
  static async findAll({ item_id, transaction_type, reference_type, from_date, to_date, limit = 200, offset = 0 } = {}) {
    let sql = `SELECT sl.*, i.item_code, i.item_name, i.unit, u.full_name AS creator_name
               FROM stock_ledger sl
               LEFT JOIN items i ON i.id = sl.item_id
               LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = sl.created_by
               WHERE 1=1`;
    const params = [];
    if (item_id)          { sql += " AND sl.item_id = ?";          params.push(item_id); }
    if (transaction_type) { sql += " AND sl.transaction_type = ?"; params.push(transaction_type); }
    if (reference_type)   { sql += " AND sl.reference_type = ?";   params.push(reference_type); }
    if (from_date)        { sql += " AND sl.created_at >= ?";       params.push(from_date); }
    if (to_date)          { sql += " AND sl.created_at <= ?";       params.push(to_date); }
    sql += " ORDER BY sl.id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?";
    params.push(Number(limit), Number(offset));
    const [rows] = await pool.query(sql, params);
    return rows;
  }

  static async findById(id) {
    const [rows] = await pool.query(
      `SELECT sl.*, i.item_code, i.item_name
       FROM stock_ledger sl
       LEFT JOIN items i ON i.id = sl.item_id
       WHERE sl.id = ?`, [id]
    );
    return rows[0] || null;
  }

  static async findByItem(itemId, limit = 100) {
    const [rows] = await pool.query(
      `SELECT * FROM stock_ledger WHERE item_id = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?`,
      [itemId, Number(limit)]
    );
    return rows;
  }

  // Tao 1 but toan kho: cap nhat items.stock_quantity + ghi stock_ledger
  static async create(data, conn = null) {
    const exec = conn || pool;
    const [itemRows] = await exec.query("SELECT stock_quantity FROM items WHERE id = ?", [data.item_id]);
    if (itemRows.length === 0) throw new Error(`Item id=${data.item_id} not found`);

    const before = Number(itemRows[0].stock_quantity);
    const qty = Number(data.quantity);
    let after;
    if (data.transaction_type === "IN")      after = before + qty;
    else if (data.transaction_type === "OUT") after = before - qty;
    else if (data.transaction_type === "ADJUST") after = qty; // ADJUST = set new balance
    else throw new Error("Invalid transaction_type");

    await exec.query("UPDATE items SET stock_quantity = ? WHERE id = ?", [after, data.item_id]);

    const [result] = await exec.query(
      `INSERT INTO stock_ledger
         (item_id, transaction_type, reference_type, reference_id, quantity,
          balance_before, balance_after, unit_cost, notes, created_by)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
      [
        data.item_id,
        data.transaction_type,
        data.reference_type || "MANUAL",
        data.reference_id || null,
        qty,
        before,
        after,
        data.unit_cost || 0,
        data.notes || null,
        data.created_by || null
      ]
    );
    return { id: result.insertId, balance_before: before, balance_after: after };
  }
}

module.exports = StockLedger;
'@

$ordersRoute = @'
const express = require("express");
const router = express.Router();
const { pool } = require("../config/db");
const Order = require("../models/Order");
const StockLedger = require("../models/StockLedger");

const authMod = require("../middleware/auth");

const rbacMod = require("../middleware/rbac");
const authorize = rbacMod.authorize || rbacMod.checkRole || rbacMod.requireRole || rbacMod.default || rbacMod;

router.use(authenticate);

// GET /api/orders
router.get("/", async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const data = await Order.findAll(req.query);
    res.json({ success: true, data, count: data.length });
  } catch (err) { next(err); }
});

// GET /api/orders/:id
router.get("/:id", async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const order = await Order.findById(req.params.id);
    if (!order) return res.status(404).json({ success: false, message: "Order not found" });
    order.items = await Order.getItems(order.id);
    res.json({ success: true, data: order });
  } catch (err) { next(err); }
});

// POST /api/orders
router.post("/", authorize(["ADMIN", "MANAGER", "SALES", "WAREHOUSE"]), async (req, res, next) => {
  const conn = await pool.getConnection();
  try {
    await conn.beginTransaction();
    const body = req.body;
    const code = body.order_code || await Order.generateCode(body.order_type);

    const orderId = await Order.create({
      ...body,
      order_code: code,
      created_by: req.user ? req.user.id : null
    }, conn);

    if (Array.isArray(body.items) && body.items.length > 0) {
      for (const it of body.items) {
        const total = Number(it.quantity) * Number(it.unit_price);
        await conn.query(
          `INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, item_id, quantity, unit_price, total_price, notes)
           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
          [orderId, it.item_id, it.quantity, it.unit_price, total, it.notes || null]
        );
      }
      await Order.recalcTotal(orderId, conn);
    }

    await conn.commit();
    res.status(201).json({ success: true, data: { id: orderId, order_code: code } });
  } catch (err) {
    await conn.rollback();
    next(err);
  } finally {
    conn.release();
  }
});

// PUT /api/orders/:id
router.put("/:id", authorize(["ADMIN", "MANAGER", "SALES"]), async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const ok = await Order.update(req.params.id, req.body);
    if (!ok) return res.status(404).json({ success: false, message: "Order not found or no changes" });
    res.json({ success: true });
  } catch (err) { next(err); }
});

// DELETE /api/orders/:id
router.delete("/:id", authorize(["ADMIN", "MANAGER"]), async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const ok = await Order.remove(req.params.id);
    if (!ok) return res.status(404).json({ success: false, message: "Order not found" });
    res.json({ success: true });
  } catch (err) { next(err); }
});

// POST /api/orders/:id/confirm  -> sinh stock_ledger
router.post("/:id/confirm", authorize(["ADMIN", "MANAGER", "WAREHOUSE"]), async (req, res, next) => {
  const conn = await pool.getConnection();
  try {
    await conn.beginTransaction();
    const order = await Order.findById(req.params.id);
    if (!order) throw new Error("Order not found");
    if (order.status !== "DRAFT") throw new Error(`Cannot confirm order in status ${order.status}`);

    const items = await Order.getItems(order.id);
    if (items.length === 0) throw new Error("Order has no items");

    const transType = order.order_type === "SALES" ? "OUT" : "IN";
    for (const it of items) {
      await StockLedger.create({
        item_id: it.item_id,
        transaction_type: transType,
        reference_type: "ORDER",
        reference_id: order.id,
        quantity: it.quantity,
        unit_cost: it.unit_price,
        notes: `Auto from ${order.order_code}`,
        created_by: req.user ? req.user.id : null
      }, conn);
    }

    await conn.query("UPDATE orders SET status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE id = ?", [order.id]);
    await conn.commit();
    res.json({ success: true, message: "Order confirmed and stock updated", transaction_type: transType });
  } catch (err) {
    await conn.rollback();
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: err.message });
  } finally {
    conn.release();
  }
});

module.exports = router;
'@

require('dotenv').config();
const fs = require('fs');
const csv = require('csv-parser');
const { pool } = require('./src/config/db');

const FILE_428_MA = "C:\\Users\\trinh\\Downloads\\SUNNY_FLEX3D_BO_HO_SO_TONG_HOP_GUI_DON_VI_PHAN_MEM\\03_DU_LIEU_DOI_SOAT\\Bang_doi_chieu_428_ma.csv";
const FILE_458_TINH_HUONG = "C:\\Users\\trinh\\Downloads\\SUNNY_FLEX3D_BO_HO_SO_TONG_HOP_GUI_DON_VI_PHAN_MEM\\03_DU_LIEU_DOI_SOAT\\Bang_phan_loai_458_tinh_huong.csv";

// Hàm đọc CSV có xử lý BOM
const readCSV = (filePath) => {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const results = [];
    fs.createReadStream(filePath)
      .pipe(csv({
        mapHeaders: ({ header }) => header.trim().replace(/^\uFEFF/, '')
      }))
      .on('data', (data) => results.push(data))
      .on('end', () => resolve(results))
      .on('error', (error) => reject(error));
  });
};

(async () => {
  try {
    console.log("⏳ Đang đọc file đối chiếu 428 mã...");
    const data428 = await readCSV(FILE_428_MA);
    
    // IN RA CÁC CỘT THỰC TẾ ĐỂ KIỂM TRA
    if (data428.length > 0) {
      console.log("🔍 Các cột trong file 428 mã:", Object.keys(data428[0]));
    } else {
      console.log("❌ File 428 mã rỗng hoặc không đọc được!");
      process.exit(1);
    }

    const validCodes = new Set();
    data428.forEach(row => {
      const code = row['Mã V6'] || row['Mã nguồn'] || row['Mã'];
      if (code) validCodes.add(code.trim().toUpperCase());
    });
    console.log(`✅ Tìm thấy ${validCodes.size} mã hợp lệ trong danh mục.`);

    console.log("⏳ Đang đọc file 458 tình huống chi tiết...");
    const data458 = await readCSV(FILE_458_TINH_HUONG);
    
    if (data458.length > 0) {
      console.log("🔍 Các cột trong file 458 tình huống:", Object.keys(data458[0]));
    }

    let importedCount = 0;
    let skippedCount = 0;

    console.log("⏳ Bắt đầu nạp vào Database...");
    
    for (let row of data458) {
      const code = (row['Mã nguồn'] || row['Mã V6'] || row['Mã'] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      if (!code) continue;

      // Chỉ import nếu mã nằm trong danh mục 428 mã chuẩn
      if (validCodes.has(code)) {
        const title = row['Tên tình huống bằng tiếng Việt'] || row['Tên V6 nguyên bản'] || 'Chưa có tên';
        const tags = row['Loại'] || row['Loại V6'] || '';
        
        const dataToCheck = row['Dữ liệu cần kiểm'] || 'Không có';
        const howToCheck = row['Cách kiểm tra cụ thể'] || 'Không có';
        const action = row['Biện pháp xử lý'] || 'Không có';
        const evidence = row['Bằng chứng hoàn thành'] || 'Không có';

        const steps = `1. Dữ liệu cần kiểm: ${dataToCheck}\n2. Cách kiểm tra: ${howToCheck}\n3. Biện pháp xử lý: ${action}\n4. Bằng chứng hoàn thành: ${evidence}`;
        const owner = 'Hệ thống V6';

        await pool.query(`
          INSERT INTO sop_docs (code, title, steps, tags, owner, visibility, approved)
          VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'internal', 1)
          ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE 
            title = VALUES(title), 
            steps = VALUES(steps), 
            tags = VALUES(tags),
            owner = VALUES(owner)
        `, [code, title, steps, tags, owner]);
        
        importedCount++;
      } else {
        skippedCount++;
      }
    }
    
    console.log(`\n🎉 HOÀN TẤT!`);
    console.log(`✅ Đã nạp thành công: ${importedCount} quy trình SOP vào Database.`);
    console.log(`⏭️ Đã bỏ qua: ${skippedCount} tình huống (không nằm trong 428 mã chuẩn).`);
    process.exit(0);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("❌ Lỗi Import:", err.message);
    process.exit(1);
  }
})();

const pool = mysql.createPool({
  host: process.env.DB_HOST,
  user: process.env.DB_USER,
  password: process.env.DB_PASSWORD,
  database: process.env.DB_NAME,
  port: process.env.DB_PORT,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false }
});

const FILE_CSV = "C:\\Users\\trinh\\Downloads\\SUNNY_FLEX3D_BO_QUY_TAC_115_MA_GUI_PHAN_MEM\\SUNNY_FLEX3D_115_MA_GIA_TRI_QUY_DOI_DOI_CHIEU.csv";

const readCSV = (filePath) => {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const results = [];
    fs.createReadStream(filePath)
      .pipe(csv({
        mapHeaders: ({ header }) => header.trim().replace(/^\uFEFF/, '')
      }))
      .on('data', (data) => results.push(data))
      .on('end', () => resolve(results))
      .on('error', (error) => reject(error));
  });
};

(async () => {
  try {
    console.log("⏳ Đang đọc file CSV...");
    const data = await readCSV(FILE_CSV);
    console.log(`✅ Đọc được ${data.length} dòng dữ liệu.`);

    console.log("⏳ Đang nạp dữ liệu vào Database...");
    let importedCount = 0;

    for (let row of data) {
      const code = (row['Mã'] || '').trim();
      if (!code) continue;

      const groupName = (row['Nhóm'] || '').trim();
      const behavior = (row['Hành vi'] || '').trim();
      const fineAmountStr = (row['Giá trị quy đổi quản trị'] || '0').replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
      const fineAmount = parseInt(fineAmountStr) || 0;
      const verifyMethod = (row['Bước xác minh'] || '').trim();
      const remedy = (row['Hướng khắc phục'] || '').trim();
      const regulation = (row['Quy định tiền'] || '').trim();
      const colorStatus = (row['Màu khi chưa phát sinh'] || '').trim();

      await pool.query(`
        INSERT INTO violation_rules (code, group_name, behavior, fine_amount, verify_method, remedy, regulation, color_status)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE 
          group_name = VALUES(group_name),
          behavior = VALUES(behavior),
          fine_amount = VALUES(fine_amount),
          verify_method = VALUES(verify_method),
          remedy = VALUES(remedy),
          regulation = VALUES(regulation),
          color_status = VALUES(color_status)
      `, [code, groupName, behavior, fineAmount, verifyMethod, remedy, regulation, colorStatus]);

      importedCount++;
    }

    console.log(`\n🎉 HOÀN TẤT!`);
    console.log(`✅ Đã nạp thành công: ${importedCount} mã vi phạm vào Database.`);
    process.exit(0);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("❌ Lỗi Import:", err.message);
    process.exit(1);
  }
})();

require('dotenv').config(); // <--- THÊM DÒNG NÀY ĐỂ NẠP CẤU HÌNH AIVEN
const { pool } = require('./src/config/db');

const randomPhone = () => '09' + Math.floor(10000000 + Math.random() * 90000000);
const randomInt = (min, max) => Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min + 1)) + min;
const randomChoice = (arr) => arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];

async function seedData() {
  console.log('⏳ Đang bơm dữ liệu mẫu (Seed Data)...');
  const connection = await pool.getConnection();
  
  try {
    await connection.beginTransaction();

    // 1. Xóa dữ liệu cũ (chỉ xóa partners và items, giữ nguyên users)
    await connection.query('DELETE FROM partners');
    await connection.query('DELETE FROM items');
    await connection.query('ALTER TABLE partners AUTO_INCREMENT = 1');
    await connection.query('ALTER TABLE items AUTO_INCREMENT = 1');
    console.log('  - Đã dọn dẹp dữ liệu Partners và Items cũ.');

    // 2. Seed 20 Khách hàng
    const customers = [
      { name: 'Công ty TNHH Xây Dựng An Phát', cat: 'Nhà thầu' },
      { name: 'Công ty CP Nội Thất Hòa Phát', cat: 'Doanh nghiệp' },
      { name: 'Đại lý Vật Liệu Minh Khang', cat: 'Đại lý' },
      { name: 'Cửa hàng Trang Trí Sài Gòn', cat: 'Khách buôn' },
      { name: 'Công ty TNHH Kiến Trúc Nhà Đẹp', cat: 'Nhà thầu' },
      { name: 'Chị Nguyễn Thị Hồng (Khách lẻ)', cat: 'Khách lẻ' },
      { name: 'Anh Trần Văn Nam (Khách lẻ)', cat: 'Khách lẻ' },
      { name: 'Công ty CP Vật Liệu Xây Dựng Miền Nam', cat: 'Doanh nghiệp' },
      { name: 'Đại lý Thảm 3D Hoàng Gia', cat: 'Đại lý' },
      { name: 'Công ty TNHH Thiết Kế Nội Thất 24h', cat: 'Doanh nghiệp' }
    ];

    for (let i = 1; i <= 20; i++) {
      const c = customers[i % 10];
      await connection.query(
        `INSERT INTO partners (type, code, name, company_name, contact_person, phone, email, tax_code, address, category, credit_limit, payment_term) 
         VALUES ('customer', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
        [
          `KH${String(i).padStart(3, '0')}`, c.name, c.name, `Người liên hệ ${i}`, randomPhone(),
          `khachhang${i}@gmail.com`, `030${randomInt(1000000, 9999999)}`, `Số ${i} Đường Lê Lợi, TP.HCM`,
          c.cat, randomInt(10, 100) * 1000000, randomChoice([15, 30, 45])
        ]
      );
    }
    console.log('  - Đã tạo 20 Khách hàng.');

    // 3. Seed 10 Nhà cung cấp
    const suppliers = ['Công ty Nhựa Duy Tân', 'Tập đoàn Hóa chất Đức Giang', 'Công ty Bao Bì Tân Tiến', 'Công ty Sơn Jotun', 'NCC Vật Tư Phụ Liệu 1', 'Kho Sỉ Nhựa PET', 'Công ty Giấy Vĩnh Tiến', 'NCC Keo Dán 3M', 'Công ty Sắt Thép Hòa Phát', 'NCC Vật Tư Tổng Hợp'];
    for (let i = 1; i <= 10; i++) {
      await connection.query(
        `INSERT INTO partners (type, code, name, company_name, contact_person, phone, email, tax_code, address, category, payment_term) 
         VALUES ('supplier', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'Nhà cung cấp', ?)`,
        [
          `NCC${String(i).padStart(3, '0')}`, suppliers[i-1], suppliers[i-1], `Sale ${i}`, randomPhone(),
          `ncc${i}@gmail.com`, `010${randomInt(1000000, 9999999)}`, `Khu Công Nghiệp số ${i}`,
          randomChoice([15, 30])
        ]
      );
    }
    console.log('  - Đã tạo 10 Nhà cung cấp.');

    // 4. Seed 15 Vật tư
    for (let i = 1; i <= 15; i++) {
      const price = randomInt(10, 100) * 1000;
      await connection.query(
        `INSERT INTO items (type, code, name, unit, price_in, min_stock, location) 
         VALUES ('material', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
        [
          `VT${String(i).padStart(3, '0')}`, `Vật tư nguyên liệu ${i}`, randomChoice(['kg', 'm', 'cuộn', 'bao']),
          price, randomInt(50, 500), `Kệ A-${i}`
        ]
      );
    }

    // 5. Seed 15 Thành phẩm (Thảm 3D)
    for (let i = 1; i <= 15; i++) {
      const thickness = randomChoice([6, 8, 10, 12, 15]);
      const priceOut = thickness * 100000 + randomInt(10, 50) * 10000;
      await connection.query(
        `INSERT INTO items (type, code, name, unit, price_out, price_floor, min_stock, spec_thickness, spec_width, spec_length, weight, location) 
         VALUES ('product', ?, ?, 'm2', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'Kho TP')`,
        [
          `TP${String(i).padStart(3, '0')}`, `Thảm 3D FLEX ${thickness}mm - Mẫu ${i}`,
          priceOut, priceOut * 0.8, randomInt(10, 100), thickness, 1.5, 20, thickness * 0.5
        ]
      );
    }
    console.log('  - Đã tạo 15 Vật tư và 15 Thành phẩm.');

    await connection.commit();
    console.log('✅ HOÀN TẤT BƠM DỮ LIỆU MẪU!');
  } catch (err) {
    await connection.rollback();
    console.error('❌ Lỗi bơm dữ liệu:', err.message);
  } finally {
    connection.release();
    process.exit(0);
  }
}

seedData();

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$base = "http://localhost:3000/api"

Write-Host "=== SUNNY AI - DAY 3 TEST ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan

# --- 1. Login admin/123 ---
$loginBody = @{ username = "admin"; password = "123" } | ConvertTo-Json
$login = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/auth/login" -Method POST -Body $loginBody -ContentType "application/json"

$token = $null
if ($login.token) { $token = $login.token }
elseif ($login.data -and $login.data.token) { $token = $login.data.token }
if (-not $token) { throw "Login failed - no token in response" }
Write-Host "[OK] Logged in. Token length = $($token.Length)" -ForegroundColor Green

$headers = @{ Authorization = "Bearer $token" }

# --- 2. Lay partner & item mau de test ---
$partners = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/partners" -Headers $headers
if (-not $partners.data -or $partners.data.Count -lt 1) { throw "No partners. Run seed_data.js first." }
$partnerId = $partners.data[0].id

$items = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/items" -Headers $headers
if (-not $items.data -or $items.data.Count -lt 2) { throw "Need >=2 items. Run seed_data.js first." }
$itemId1 = $items.data[0].id
$itemId2 = $items.data[1].id
Write-Host "[OK] partnerId=$partnerId, itemId1=$itemId1, itemId2=$itemId2" -ForegroundColor Yellow

# --- 3. Tao don hang (kem 2 dong items) ---
$orderBody = @{
    partner_id = $partnerId
    order_type = "SALES"
    notes      = "Day 3 test order"
    items      = @(
        @{ item_id = $itemId1; quantity = 5; unit_price = 100000 },
        @{ item_id = $itemId2; quantity = 3; unit_price = 250000 }
    )
} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5

$newOrder = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/orders" -Method POST -Body $orderBody -Headers $headers -ContentType "application/json"
$orderId = $newOrder.data.id
Write-Host "[OK] Created order id=$orderId code=$($newOrder.data.order_code)" -ForegroundColor Green

# --- 4. Xem chi tiet don ---
$detail = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/orders/$orderId" -Headers $headers
Write-Host "[OK] Detail: total=$($detail.data.total_amount), items=$($detail.data.items.Count)" -ForegroundColor Green

# --- 5. Them 1 order_item qua endpoint rieng ---
$addItemBody = @{
    order_id   = $orderId
    item_id    = $itemId1
    quantity   = 2
    unit_price = 90000
} | ConvertTo-Json
$added = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/order-items" -Method POST -Body $addItemBody -Headers $headers -ContentType "application/json"
$orderItemId = $added.data.id
Write-Host "[OK] Added order_item id=$orderItemId" -ForegroundColor Green

# --- 6. Update order_item ---
$updBody = @{ quantity = 4; unit_price = 95000 } | ConvertTo-Json
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/order-items/$orderItemId" -Method PUT -Body $updBody -Headers $headers -ContentType "application/json" | Out-Null
Write-Host "[OK] Updated order_item id=$orderItemId" -ForegroundColor Green

# --- 7. Confirm don hang -> sinh stock_ledger (OUT kho) ---
$confirm = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/orders/$orderId/confirm" -Method POST -Headers $headers
Write-Host "[OK] Confirm: $($confirm.message) ($($confirm.transaction_type))" -ForegroundColor Green

# --- 8. Kiem tra stock_ledger cua don ---
$ledger = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/stock-ledger?reference_type=ORDER&reference_id=$orderId" -Headers $headers
Write-Host "[OK] Ledger entries for order: $($ledger.data.Count)" -ForegroundColor Green
$ledger.data | Format-Table id, item_code, transaction_type, quantity, balance_before, balance_after -AutoSize

# --- 9. Nhap kho thu cong (ADJUST) ---
$adjustBody = @{
    item_id          = $itemId1
    transaction_type = "ADJUST"
    quantity         = 100
    notes            = "Manual adjust day3 test"
} | ConvertTo-Json
$adjust = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/stock-ledger" -Method POST -Body $adjustBody -Headers $headers -ContentType "application/json"
Write-Host "[OK] Adjust item $itemId1 : before=$($adjust.data.balance_before) after=$($adjust.data.balance_after)" -ForegroundColor Green

# --- 10. Lich su kho cua 1 item ---
$itemLedger = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/stock-ledger/item/$itemId1" -Headers $headers
Write-Host "[OK] Item $itemId1 ledger history count = $($itemLedger.data.Count)" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== ALL DAY 3 TESTS PASSED ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan

require('dotenv').config();
require('express-async-errors');   // ✅ FIX CRASH: Bắt lỗi async không cần try/catch trong mọi route

const express = require('express');
const cors = require('cors');
const { initDB } = require('./config/db');

const app = express();

// ============================================================
// MIDDLEWARE CHUNG
// ============================================================
app.use(cors());
app.use(express.json({ limit: '10mb' }));

// Health check — để kiểm tra server sống hay không
app.get('/', (req, res) => {
  res.json({
    name: 'SUNNY AI FLEX 3D API',
    status: 'ok',
    time: new Date().toISOString()
  });
});

// ============================================================
// ĐĂNG KÝ ROUTES
// ============================================================
app.use('/api/auth', require('./routes/auth'));
app.use('/api/users', require('./routes/users'));
app.use('/api/partners', require('./routes/partners'));
app.use('/api/items', require('./routes/items'));
app.use('/api/audit-logs', require('./routes/auditLogs'));
app.use('/api/orders', require('./routes/orders'));
app.use('/api/order-items', require('./routes/orderItems'));
app.use('/api/stock-ledger', require('./routes/stockLedger'));
app.use('/api/tasks', require('./routes/tasks'));
app.use('/api/incidents', require('./routes/incidents'));
app.use('/api/attendance', require('./routes/attendance'));
app.use('/api/payrolls', require('./routes/payrolls'));
app.use('/api/sop', require('./routes/sop'));
app.use('/api/dashboard', require('./routes/dashboard'));
app.use('/api/assets', require('./routes/assets'));
app.use('/api/costs', require('./routes/costs'));
app.use('/api/marketing', require('./routes/marketing'));
app.use('/api/chat-history', require('./routes/chatHistory'));
app.use('/api/shift-reports', require('./routes/shiftReports'));
app.use('/api/ai', require('./routes/ai'));

// ============================================================
// 404 HANDLER
// ============================================================
app.use((req, res) => {
  res.status(404).json({
    success: false,
    error: `Route không tồn tại: ${req.method} ${req.path}`
  });
});

// ============================================================
// GLOBAL ERROR HANDLER
// Với express-async-errors: handler này sẽ BẮT ĐƯỢC cả lỗi async
// từ bất kỳ route nào throw — dù route không có try/catch.
// ============================================================
app.use((err, req, res, next) => {
  console.error('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
  console.error('[GLOBAL ERROR]', new Date().toISOString());
  console.error('  Route:', req.method, req.path);
  console.error('  Message:', err.message);
  console.error('  Stack:', err.stack);
  console.error('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');

  // Nếu response đã gửi rồi → bỏ qua (tránh lỗi "headers already sent")
  if (res.headersSent) return next(err);

  res.status(err.status || 500).json({
    success: false,
    error: err.message || 'Lỗi hệ thống không xác định'
  });
});

// ============================================================
// KHỞI ĐỘNG SERVER
// ============================================================
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;

(async () => {
  try {
    await initDB();
    app.listen(PORT, () => {
      console.log(`🚀 Server chạy tại http://localhost:${PORT}`);
      console.log(`📋 Đã đăng ký 21 route API`);
      console.log(`🛡️  express-async-errors đã kích hoạt — lỗi async sẽ KHÔNG làm crash server`);
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('❌ Không thể khởi động server:', err.message);
    process.exit(1);
  }
})();

// ============================================================
// BẮT LỖI CUỐI CÙNG — không để Node chết vì unhandledRejection
// (Đề phòng trường hợp lỗi xảy ra TRƯỚC khi express-async-errors kịp bắt)
// ============================================================
process.on('unhandledRejection', (reason, promise) => {
  console.error('⚠️  [UNHANDLED REJECTION]', reason);
});

process.on('uncaughtException', (err) => {
  console.error('⚠️  [UNCAUGHT EXCEPTION]', err.message);
  console.error(err.stack);
});

require('dotenv').config();
const mysql = require('mysql2/promise');

const pool = mysql.createPool({
  host: process.env.DB_HOST,
  port: process.env.DB_PORT,
  user: process.env.DB_USER,
  password: process.env.DB_PASSWORD,
  database: process.env.DB_NAME,
  waitForConnections: true,
  connectionLimit: 10,
  queueLimit: 0,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false }
});

// ============================================================
// MIGRATION HELPER
// Thêm cột nếu chưa tồn tại — không crash nếu đã có
// ============================================================
const tryAddColumn = async (conn, table, column, definition) => {
  try {
    await conn.query(`ALTER TABLE \`${table}\` ADD COLUMN \`${column}\` ${definition}`);
    console.log(`   [MIGRATE] + ${table}.${column}`);
  } catch (e) {
    if (e.code !== 'ER_DUP_FIELDNAME' && e.code !== 'ER_NO_SUCH_TABLE') {
      console.warn(`   [MIGRATE] Bỏ qua ${table}.${column}: ${e.message}`);
    }
  }
};

const { pool } = require('../config/db');

const logAudit = async (userId, action, resource, refId, beforeData, afterData, note = null, ip = null) => {
  try {
    await pool.query(
      'INSERT INTO audit_logs (user_id, action, resource, ref_id, before_data, after_data, note, ip) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
      [userId, action, resource, refId, beforeData ? JSON.stringify(beforeData) : null, afterData ? JSON.stringify(afterData) : null, note, ip]
    );
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Lỗi ghi Audit Log:', err.message);
  }
};

module.exports = { logAudit };

const jwt = require('jsonwebtoken');
module.exports = (req, res, next) => {
  const token = req.header('Authorization')?.replace('Bearer ', '');
  if (!token) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Không có token' });
  try {
    const decoded = jwt.verify(token, process.env.JWT_SECRET);
    req.user = decoded;
    next();
  } catch (err) { res.status(401).json({ error: 'Token không hợp lệ' }); }
};

const PERMS = {
  users: { giam_doc: 'rw' },
  partners: { giam_doc: 'rw', ke_toan: 'rw', ctv: 'own' },
  items: { giam_doc: 'rw', ke_toan: 'rw', to_truong: 'r', cong_nhan: 'r' },
  orders: { giam_doc: 'rw', ke_toan: 'rw', ctv: 'own' },
  stock_ledger: { giam_doc: 'rw', ke_toan: 'rw', to_truong: 'r' }
};

const allow = (resource) => {
  return (req, res, next) => {
    const role = req.user.role;
    const perm = PERMS[resource]?.[role];
    if (!perm || perm === 'none') return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Không có quyền' });
    if (perm === 'own') req.scope = 'own';
    if (perm === 'team') req.scope = 'team';
    if (perm === 'approve') req.needsApproval = true;
    next();
  };
};
module.exports = { allow };

const { pool } = require('../config/db');

const Task = {
  getAll: async (assigneeId) => {
    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM tasks';
    let params = [];
    if (assigneeId) { sql += ' WHERE assignee_id = ?'; params.push(assigneeId); }
    const [rows] = await pool.query(sql + ' ORDER BY id DESC', params);
    return rows;
  },
  create: async (d) => {
    const [res] = await pool.query(
      'INSERT INTO tasks (code, title, description, assignee_id, assigned_by, team_id, priority, due, start_date, kpi_weight, evidence_required, task_type, revenue_value) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
      [d.code || 'T'+Date.now(), d.title, d.description, d.assignee_id, d.assigned_by, d.team_id, d.priority||'normal', d.due, d.start_date||null, d.kpi_weight||1, d.evidence_required!==false, d.task_type||'kpi', d.revenue_value||0]
    );
    return res.insertId;
  },
  updateStatus: async (id, status, evidence) => {
    if (status === 'done') {
      const [task] = await pool.query('SELECT evidence_required FROM tasks WHERE id = ?', [id]);
      if (task[0].evidence_required && !evidence) throw new Error('Công việc này bắt buộc phải nộp bằng chứng!');
    }
    const doneAt = status === 'done' ? new Date() : null;
    await pool.query(`UPDATE tasks SET status = ?, evidence = COALESCE(?, evidence), done_at = COALESCE(?, done_at) WHERE id = ?`, [status, evidence, doneAt, id]);
  }
};

const Attendance = {
  checkIn: async (userId, shift) => {
    const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    const [exist] = await pool.query('SELECT id FROM attendance WHERE user_id = ? AND date = ?', [userId, today]);
    if (exist.length > 0) throw new Error('Hôm nay đã chấm công vào rồi');
    await pool.query('INSERT INTO attendance (user_id, date, check_in, shift) VALUES (?, ?, NOW(), ?)', [userId, today, shift||'office']);
  },
  checkOut: async (userId) => {
    const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    const [rows] = await pool.query('SELECT id, check_in FROM attendance WHERE user_id = ? AND date = ?', [userId, today]);
    if (rows.length === 0) throw new Error('Chưa chấm công vào hôm nay');
    const checkIn = new Date(rows[0].check_in);
    const checkOut = new Date();
    const diffHours = (checkOut - checkIn) / (1000 * 60 * 60);
    const workHours = Math.min(8, diffHours);
    const otHours = Math.max(0, diffHours - 8);
    await pool.query('UPDATE attendance SET check_out = NOW(), work_hours = ?, ot_hours = ? WHERE id = ?', [workHours, otHours, rows[0].id]);
  },
  getByMonth: async (userId, period) => {
    const [rows] = await pool.query('SELECT * FROM attendance WHERE user_id = ? AND date LIKE ?', [userId, period + '%']);
    return rows;
  }
};

const Payroll = {
  calculateKPI: async (userId, period) => {
    const now = new Date();
    let startDate;
    if (period === 'day') { startDate = new Date(now.setHours(0,0,0,0)); }
    else if (period === 'week') { const day = now.getDay() || 7; startDate = new Date(now.setDate(now.getDate() - day + 1)); }
    else if (period === 'month') { startDate = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1); }
    else if (period === 'quarter') { const q = Math.floor(now.getMonth()/3); startDate = new Date(now.getFullYear(), q*3, 1); }
    else { startDate = new Date(now.getFullYear(), 0, 1); }
    const startStr = startDate.toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace('T', ' ');

    const [rows] = await pool.query(`
      SELECT SUM(kpi_weight) as total_weight, SUM(CASE WHEN status='done' AND evidence IS NOT NULL THEN kpi_weight ELSE 0 END) as done_weight
      FROM tasks WHERE assignee_id = ? AND task_type = 'kpi' AND done_at >= ?
    `, [userId, startStr]);
    
    if (!rows[0].total_weight || rows[0].total_weight == 0) return { kpi: 0, bonus: 0, rank: 'Không có KPI' };
    
    const kpiPercent = (rows[0].done_weight / rows[0].total_weight) * 100;
    let bonus = 0; let rank = 'Chưa đạt';
    if (kpiPercent >= 90) { bonus = 1500000; rank = 'Tốt'; }
    else if (kpiPercent >= 50) { bonus = 700000; rank = 'Trung bình'; }
    return { kpi: kpiPercent, bonus, rank };
  },
  generate: async (userId, period) => {
    const [users] = await pool.query(`SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ? AND status = 'active'`, [userId]);
    if (users.length === 0) throw new Error('User không tồn tại hoặc đã nghỉ việc');
    const user = users[0];

    const [att] = await pool.query('SELECT SUM(work_hours) as wh, SUM(ot_hours) as oh FROM attendance WHERE user_id = ? AND date LIKE ?', [userId, period + '%']);
    const workHours = Number(att[0].wh || 0);
    const otHours = Number(att[0].oh || 0);

    const hourlyRate = user.salary_base / (26 * 8);
    const workPay = workHours * hourlyRate;
    const otPay = otHours * hourlyRate * 1.5;

    const kpiData = await Payroll.calculateKPI(userId, 'month');
    const bhxh = user.salary_base * 0.105;
    const net = workPay + otPay + kpiData.bonus - bhxh;

    await pool.query(`
      INSERT INTO payrolls (period, user_id, salary_base, work_pay, ot_pay, kpi_bonus, bhxh_deduction, net_salary, status)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'draft')
      ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE work_pay = VALUES(work_pay), ot_pay = VALUES(ot_pay), kpi_bonus = VALUES(kpi_bonus), net_salary = VALUES(net_salary)
    `, [period, userId, user.salary_base, workPay, otPay, kpiData.bonus, bhxh, net]);

    return { kpi: kpiData, workPay, otPay, net };
  }
};

module.exports = { Task, Attendance, Payroll };

const { pool } = require('../config/db');

// ============================================================
// ✅ FIX #2: Hằng số nghiệp vụ — có thể đưa vào .env nếu cần
// ============================================================
const DEFAULT_TAX_RATE = 0.10; // 10% VAT mặc định
const VALID_ORDER_TYPES = ['sale', 'purchase'];

module.exports = {
  // ============================================================
  // GET ALL
  // ============================================================
  getAll: async (filters = {}) => {
    let sql = `
      SELECT o.*, p.name AS partner_name, u.full_name AS creator_name
      FROM orders o
      LEFT JOIN partners p ON p.id = o.partner_id
      LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.created_by
      WHERE 1=1
    `;
    const params = [];

    if (filters.type && VALID_ORDER_TYPES.includes(filters.type)) {
      sql += ' AND o.type = ?';
      params.push(filters.type);
    }
    if (filters.status) {
      sql += ' AND o.status = ?';
      params.push(filters.status);
    }
    if (filters.partner_id) {
      sql += ' AND o.partner_id = ?';
      params.push(filters.partner_id);
    }
    if (filters.payment_status) {
      sql += ' AND o.payment_status = ?';
      params.push(filters.payment_status);
    }
    if (filters.keyword) {
      sql += ' AND o.code LIKE ?';
      params.push(`%${filters.keyword}%`);
    }

    sql += ' ORDER BY o.id DESC';
    const [rows] = await pool.query(sql, params);
    return rows;
  },

  // ============================================================
  // FIND BY ID
  // ============================================================
  findById: async (id) => {
    const [rows] = await pool.query('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [id]);
    return rows[0] || null;
  },

  // ============================================================
  // GET ITEMS
  // ============================================================
  getItems: async (orderId) => {
    const [rows] = await pool.query(`
      SELECT oi.*, i.code AS item_code, i.name AS item_name, i.unit
      FROM order_items oi
      JOIN items i ON i.id = oi.item_id
      WHERE oi.order_id = ?
      ORDER BY oi.id
    `, [orderId]);
    return rows;
  },

  // ============================================================
  // CREATE — Tạo đơn hàng
  // ✅ FIX #2: KHÔNG tin client gửi sub_total/total.
  //            Chỉ nhận discount, tax_amount, shipping_fee, tax_rate.
  //            Insert với total = 0, recalcTotal sẽ điền sau khi addItem.
  // ============================================================
  create: async (d, conn = null) => {
    const exec = conn || pool;

    // ✅ FIX #3: Validate tầng model (phòng khi gọi trực tiếp, không qua route)
    if (!d.type || !VALID_ORDER_TYPES.includes(d.type)) {
      throw new Error('type phải là "sale" hoặc "purchase"');
    }
    if (!d.partner_id) throw new Error('Thiếu partner_id');
    if (!d.code) throw new Error('Thiếu code');

    const [res] = await exec.query(`
      INSERT INTO orders
        (type, code, partner_id, sub_total, discount, tax_amount, shipping_fee,
         total, require_full_payment, delivery_address, due_date, note, created_by)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `, [
      d.type,
      d.code,
      d.partner_id,
      // ✅ FIX #2: Không nhận sub_total và total từ client
      0,                                          // sub_total
      Number(d.discount) || 0,                    // discount (client được phép)
      Number(d.tax_amount) || 0,                  // tax_amount (client có thể override)
      Number(d.shipping_fee) || 0,                // shipping_fee (client được phép)
      0,                                          // total = 0, sẽ recalc
      d.require_full_payment !== false,           // default true
      d.delivery_address || null,
      d.due_date || null,
      d.note || null,
      d.created_by || null
    ]);
    return res.insertId;
  },

  // ============================================================
  // ADD ITEM
  // ============================================================
  addItem: async (orderId, item, conn = null) => {
    const exec = conn || pool;
    if (!orderId) throw new Error('Thiếu orderId');
    if (!item.item_id) throw new Error('Thiếu item_id');
    if (Number(item.qty) <= 0) throw new Error(`Số lượng phải > 0 (item_id=${item.item_id})`);
    if (Number(item.unit_price) < 0) throw new Error(`Đơn giá không được âm (item_id=${item.item_id})`);

    const amount = Number(item.qty) * Number(item.unit_price);
    await exec.query(
      'INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, item_id, qty, unit_price, amount) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
      [orderId, item.item_id, item.qty, item.unit_price, amount]
    );
    await module.exports.recalcTotal(orderId, exec);
  },

  // ============================================================
  // RECALC TOTAL
  // ✅ FIX #1 (QUAN TRỌNG NHẤT):
  //   - sub_total = SUM(items.amount)  ← KHÔNG ghi đè lẫn discount/tax/shipping
  //   - total = sub_total - discount + tax_amount + shipping_fee
  //   - Nếu tax_amount = 0 → tự tính theo tax_rate (mặc định 10%)
  // ============================================================
  recalcTotal: async (orderId, conn = null) => {
    const exec = conn || pool;

    // Bước 1: Lấy lại đơn hàng hiện tại để đọc discount/shipping_fee/tax_amount
    const [orderRows] = await exec.query(
      'SELECT discount, tax_amount, shipping_fee FROM orders WHERE id = ?',
      [orderId]
    );
    if (orderRows.length === 0) throw new Error(`Không tìm thấy đơn id=${orderId}`);

    const discount    = Number(orderRows[0].discount) || 0;
    const shippingFee = Number(orderRows[0].shipping_fee) || 0;
    let   taxAmount   = Number(orderRows[0].tax_amount) || 0;

    // Bước 2: Tính sub_total = SUM(items)
    const [sumRows] = await exec.query(
      'SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS sub_total FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?',
      [orderId]
    );
    const subTotal = Number(sumRows[0].sub_total);

    // Bước 3: Nếu tax_amount chưa được set (0) thì tự tính theo VAT mặc định
    if (taxAmount === 0 && subTotal > 0) {
      taxAmount = Math.round(subTotal * DEFAULT_TAX_RATE);
    }

    // Bước 4: Tính total cuối cùng
    const total = subTotal - discount + taxAmount + shippingFee;

    // Bước 5: Ghi đè lại toàn bộ (không tin giá trị cũ)
    await exec.query(
      'UPDATE orders SET sub_total = ?, tax_amount = ?, total = ? WHERE id = ?',
      [subTotal, taxAmount, total, orderId]
    );

    return { sub_total: subTotal, discount, tax_amount: taxAmount, shipping_fee: shippingFee, total };
  },

  // ============================================================
  // APPROVE — Duyệt đơn
  // ✅ Bonus: cập nhật updated_at tự động (MySQL ON UPDATE đã lo, không cần)
  // ============================================================
  approve: async (id, approvedBy, conn = null) => {
    const exec = conn || pool;
    await exec.query(
      "UPDATE orders SET status = 'approved', approved_by = ? WHERE id = ? AND status = 'draft'",
      [approvedBy, id]
    );
  },

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ BONUS: Các hàm hữu ích cho tương lai (chưa dùng ngay)
  // ============================================================

  // Cập nhật trạng thái đơn (VD: delivered, done, cancelled)
  updateStatus: async (id, status, conn = null) => {
    const VALID_STATUSES = ['draft', 'pending', 'approved', 'delivered', 'done', 'cancelled'];
    if (!VALID_STATUSES.includes(status)) {
      throw new Error(`status không hợp lệ: ${status}`);
    }
    const exec = conn || pool;
    await exec.query('UPDATE orders SET status = ? WHERE id = ?', [status, id]);
  },

  // Hủy đơn (chỉ cho phép khi draft hoặc pending)
  cancel: async (id, note = null, conn = null) => {
    const exec = conn || pool;
    const [rows] = await exec.query('SELECT status FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [id]);
    if (rows.length === 0) throw new Error('Không tìm thấy đơn');
    if (!['draft', 'pending'].includes(rows[0].status)) {
      throw new Error(`Không thể hủy đơn ở trạng thái "${rows[0].status}"`);
    }
    await exec.query(
      "UPDATE orders SET status = 'cancelled', note = COALESCE(?, note) WHERE id = ?",
      [note, id]
    );
  }
};

const { pool } = require('../config/db');
const Order = require('./Order');

// ============================================================
// ✅ BONUS: Helper validate item_id tồn tại và đúng loại
// ============================================================
const validateItemForOrder = async (itemId, orderType, exec) => {
  const [rows] = await exec.query('SELECT id, type, name FROM items WHERE id = ?', [itemId]);
  if (rows.length === 0) throw new Error(`Không tìm thấy hàng hóa id=${itemId}`);

  const item = rows[0];
  // Đơn sale → chỉ chọn product; đơn purchase → chỉ chọn material
  if (orderType === 'sale' && item.type !== 'product') {
    throw new Error(`Đơn bán chỉ được chọn thành phẩm, "${item.name}" là vật tư`);
  }
  if (orderType === 'purchase' && item.type !== 'material') {
    throw new Error(`Đơn mua chỉ được chọn vật tư, "${item.name}" là thành phẩm`);
  }
  return item;
};

class OrderItem {
  // ============================================================
  // GET ALL
  // ============================================================
  static async findAll({ order_id, item_id, limit = 200, offset = 0 } = {}) {
    let sql = `
      SELECT oi.*, i.code AS item_code, i.name AS item_name, i.unit, o.code AS order_code
      FROM order_items oi
      JOIN items i ON i.id = oi.item_id
      JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
      WHERE 1=1
    `;
    const params = [];
    if (order_id) { sql += ' AND oi.order_id = ?'; params.push(order_id); }
    if (item_id)  { sql += ' AND oi.item_id = ?';  params.push(item_id); }
    sql += ' ORDER BY oi.id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?';
    params.push(Number(limit), Number(offset));
    const [rows] = await pool.query(sql, params);
    return rows;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // FIND BY ID
  // ============================================================
  static async findById(id) {
    const [rows] = await pool.query(`
      SELECT oi.*, i.code AS item_code, i.name AS item_name
      FROM order_items oi
      JOIN items i ON i.id = oi.item_id
      WHERE oi.id = ?
    `, [id]);
    return rows[0] || null;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // CREATE
  // ✅ FIX #1: Thêm conn để transaction hoạt động
  // ✅ FIX #2: Delegate sang Order.addItem() — logic 1 nơi duy nhất
  // ✅ FIX #4: Validate item.type phù hợp với order.type
  // ✅ Trả FULL object sau create
  // ============================================================
  static async create(data, conn = null) {
    const exec = conn || pool;

    // Validate cơ bản
    if (!data.order_id) throw new Error('Thiếu order_id');
    if (!data.item_id) throw new Error('Thiếu item_id');
    if (Number(data.qty) <= 0) throw new Error('Số lượng phải > 0');
    if (Number(data.unit_price) < 0) throw new Error('Đơn giá không được âm');

    // Validate order tồn tại + lấy type
    const [orderCheck] = await exec.query('SELECT id, type FROM orders WHERE id = ?', [data.order_id]);
    if (orderCheck.length === 0) {
      throw new Error(`Không tìm thấy đơn id=${data.order_id}`);
    }
    const orderType = orderCheck[0].type;

    // ✅ FIX #4: Validate item.type phù hợp
    await validateItemForOrder(data.item_id, orderType, exec);

    // ✅ FIX #2: Delegate sang Order.addItem — tự INSERT + recalcTotal
    await Order.addItem(data.order_id, {
      item_id: data.item_id,
      qty: data.qty,
      unit_price: data.unit_price
    }, exec);

    // Lấy ID vừa tạo (dòng mới nhất của đơn)
    const [newRows] = await exec.query(
      `SELECT oi.*, i.code AS item_code, i.name AS item_name, i.unit
       FROM order_items oi
       JOIN items i ON i.id = oi.item_id
       WHERE oi.order_id = ? AND oi.item_id = ?
       ORDER BY oi.id DESC LIMIT 1`,
      [data.order_id, data.item_id]
    );

    return newRows[0];
  }

  // ============================================================
  // UPDATE
  // ✅ FIX #1: Thêm conn để transaction hoạt động
  // ✅ FIX #5: Validate + update, dùng Order.recalcTotal() để tính lại tổng
  // ============================================================
  static async update(id, data, conn = null) {
    const exec = conn || pool;

    const existing = await this.findById(id);
    if (!existing) return false;

    const qty = data.qty !== undefined ? Number(data.qty) : Number(existing.qty);
    const unit_price = data.unit_price !== undefined ? Number(data.unit_price) : Number(existing.unit_price);

    if (qty <= 0) throw new Error('Số lượng phải > 0');
    if (unit_price < 0) throw new Error('Đơn giá không được âm');

    const amount = qty * unit_price;
    await exec.query(
      'UPDATE order_items SET qty = ?, unit_price = ?, amount = ? WHERE id = ?',
      [qty, unit_price, amount, id]
    );

    // Tính lại tổng đơn — dùng exec để dính transaction
    await Order.recalcTotal(existing.order_id, exec);

    return true;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // REMOVE
  // ✅ FIX #1: Thêm conn để transaction hoạt động
  // ============================================================
  static async remove(id, conn = null) {
    const exec = conn || pool;

    const existing = await this.findById(id);
    if (!existing) return false;

    await exec.query('DELETE FROM order_items WHERE id = ?', [id]);
    await Order.recalcTotal(existing.order_id, exec);

    return true;
  }
}

module.exports = OrderItem;

const { pool } = require('../config/db');

module.exports = {
  // Lấy toàn bộ lịch sử kho
  getAll: async () => {
    const [r] = await pool.query('SELECT * FROM stock_ledger ORDER BY id DESC');
    return r;
  },

  // Lấy tồn kho hiện tại của 1 item (tính động từ SUM(signed_qty))
  getBalance: async (itemId) => {
    const [rows] = await pool.query(
      'SELECT COALESCE(SUM(signed_qty), 0) AS stock FROM stock_ledger WHERE item_id = ?',
      [itemId]
    );
    return Number(rows[0].stock);
  },

  // Lịch sử kho của 1 item (dùng khi cần xem chi tiết)
  findByItem: async (itemId, limit = 100) => {
    const [rows] = await pool.query(
      'SELECT * FROM stock_ledger WHERE item_id = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?',
      [itemId, Number(limit)]
    );
    return rows;
  },

  // Lấy 1 dòng stock_ledger
  findById: async (id) => {
    const [rows] = await pool.query('SELECT * FROM stock_ledger WHERE id = ?', [id]);
    return rows[0] || null;
  },

  // Tạo bút toán kho
  // ✅ ĐÃ SỬA: Bỏ hoàn toàn query SELECT stock_quantity (cột không tồn tại)
  // ✅ ĐÃ THÊM: Validate + ghi đủ các cột batch_no, note
  // ✅ ĐÃ THÊM: Tham số conn để có thể truyền transaction từ route
  create: async (d, conn = null) => {
    const exec = conn || pool;

    // Validate bắt buộc
    if (!d.item_id) throw new Error('Thiếu item_id');
    if (!['in', 'out', 'adjust'].includes(d.type)) {
      throw new Error("type phải là 'in', 'out' hoặc 'adjust'");
    }
    if (Number(d.qty) <= 0) throw new Error('Số lượng (qty) phải > 0');

    // Kiểm tra item có tồn tại (chỉ SELECT id, không query cột stock_quantity)
    const [item] = await exec.query('SELECT id FROM items WHERE id = ?', [d.item_id]);
    if (item.length === 0) throw new Error(`Không tìm thấy mặt hàng id=${d.item_id}`);

    // Tự tính signed_qty nếu chưa truyền
    let signed = d.signed_qty;
    if (signed === undefined || signed === null) {
      signed = d.type === 'out' ? -Math.abs(d.qty) : Math.abs(d.qty);
    }

    const sql = `
      INSERT INTO stock_ledger 
        (item_id, type, qty, signed_qty, unit_cost, batch_no, ref_type, ref_id, note, created_by)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `;
    await exec.query(sql, [
      d.item_id,
      d.type,
      d.qty,
      signed,
      d.unit_cost || 0,
      d.batch_no || null,
      d.ref_type || 'manual',
      d.ref_id || null,
      d.note || null,
      d.created_by || null
    ]);
  }
};

const { pool } = require('../config/db');

module.exports = {
  findByUsername: async (username) => {
    const [rows] = await pool.query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ? AND status = 'active'", [username]);
    return rows[0];
  },
  findById: async (id) => {
    const [rows] = await pool.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?', [id]);
    return rows[0];
  },
  getAll: async () => {
    const [rows] = await pool.query('SELECT id, username, full_name, role, status, team_id, phone, salary_base FROM users');
    return rows;
  },
  create: async (d) => {
    const sql = `
      INSERT INTO users (
        username, password_hash, role, status, full_name, dob, gender, cccd, cccd_date, cccd_place, 
        phone, email, permanent_address, current_address, emergency_contact, team_id, position, 
        join_date, contract_type, salary_base, bank_account, bank_name, tax_code, bhxh_code
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `;
    const values = [
      d.username, d.password_hash, d.role, d.status || 'active', d.full_name, d.dob || null, d.gender || null, 
      d.cccd || null, d.cccd_date || null, d.cccd_place || null, d.phone || null, d.email || null, 
      d.permanent_address || null, d.current_address || null, d.emergency_contact || null, 
      d.team_id || null, d.position || null, d.join_date || null, d.contract_type || null, 
      d.salary_base || 0, d.bank_account || null, d.bank_name || null, d.tax_code || null, d.bxh_code || null
    ];
    const [result] = await pool.query(sql, values);
    return result.insertId;
  },
  countAll: async () => {
    const [rows] = await pool.query('SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM users');
    return rows[0].count;
  },
  update: async (id, d) => {
    const sql = `
      UPDATE users SET 
        role = ?, status = ?, full_name = ?, dob = ?, gender = ?, cccd = ?, cccd_date = ?, cccd_place = ?, 
        phone = ?, email = ?, permanent_address = ?, current_address = ?, emergency_contact = ?, 
        team_id = ?, position = ?, join_date = ?, contract_type = ?, salary_base = ?, 
        bank_account = ?, bank_name = ?, tax_code = ?, bhxh_code = ?
      WHERE id = ?
    `;
    const values = [
      d.role, d.status, d.full_name, d.dob || null, d.gender || null, d.cccd || null, d.cccd_date || null, d.cccd_place || null, 
      d.phone || null, d.email || null, d.permanent_address || null, d.current_address || null, d.emergency_contact || null, 
      d.team_id || null, d.position || null, d.join_date || null, d.contract_type || null, d.salary_base || 0, 
      d.bank_account || null, d.bank_name || null, d.tax_code || null, d.bhxh_code || null, id
    ];
    await pool.query(sql, values);
  },
  // Hàm xóa mềm (Đổi trạng thái)
  changeStatus: async (id, status) => {
    await pool.query('UPDATE users SET status = ? WHERE id = ?', [status, id]);
  },
  // Hàm đổi mật khẩu
  updatePassword: async (id, hash) => {
    await pool.query('UPDATE users SET password_hash = ? WHERE id = ?', [hash, id]);
  }
};

const express = require('express'); const router = express.Router();
const { processAIChat } = require('../services/aiService');
const { pool } = require('../config/db');
const auth = require('../middleware/auth');

router.post('/chat', auth, async (req, res) => {
  const { question, session_id } = req.body;
  if (!question) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Vui lòng nhập câu hỏi' });

  if (req.user.role !== 'giam_doc' && question.length > 10000) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Câu hỏi vượt quá 10.000 ký tự.' });
  }

  const sessionId = session_id || 'default_session';
  const userId = req.user.id;
  const role = req.user.role;

  try {
    if (role !== 'giam_doc') {
      const [count] = await pool.query(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM audit_logs WHERE user_id = ? AND action = 'AI_ASK' AND DATE(at) = CURDATE()",
        [userId]
      );
      if (count[0].c >= 100) {
        return res.status(429).json({ error: 'Bạn đã đạt giới hạn 100 câu hỏi/ngày.' });
      }
    }

    const result = await processAIChat(userId, role, sessionId, question);
    await pool.query(`INSERT INTO audit_logs (user_id, action, resource, note, at) VALUES (?, 'AI_ASK', 'ai', ?, NOW())`, [userId, 'Hỏi AI']);
    
    res.json({ success: true, answer: result.answer });
  } catch (err) { 
    // Bọc lỗi để không bao giờ crash server
    console.error("AI Route Error:", err.message);
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, answer: "Xin lỗi, hệ thống AI đang bận hoặc chưa được cấu hình API Key. Vui lòng thử lại sau." }); 
  }
});

module.exports = router;
